Acid Splash.name: 酸液濺爆
Acid Splash.description:
你在範圍內的一點創造出一個酸液泡泡，其隨即爆炸，覆蓋5尺半徑的球形區域，在球形區域內的每個生物都必須成功通過一次敏捷豁免，否則承受1d6強酸傷害。

【戲法升級】 當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d6、11級3d6、17級4d6。

Aid.name: 援助術
Aid.description:
選擇射程內至多三個生物。每個目標的最大生命值和當前生命值在法術持續時間內提升5點。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，每個目標的生命值就額外提高5點。

Foundry 註記

預設的「治療」行動被設定為多個主動效果，用以代表此法術所提供的暫時生命值上限。

使用者應依施放此法術所用的法術位環階，套用對應的主動效果。

Level 6: +25 Max HP.name: 6環：+25最大HP
Level 6: +25 Max HP.description: 目標的最大生命值和當前生命值在法術持續時間內提升。

Level 7: +30 Max HP.name: 7環：+30最大HP
Level 7: +30 Max HP.description: 目標的最大生命值和當前生命值在法術持續時間內提升。

Level 8: +35 Max HP.name: 8環：+35最大HP
Level 8: +35 Max HP.description: 目標的最大生命值和當前生命值在法術持續時間內提升。

Level 5: +20 Max HP.name: 5環：+20最大HP
Level 5: +20 Max HP.description: 目標的最大生命值和當前生命值在法術持續時間內提升。

Level 4: +15 Max HP.description: 目標的最大生命值和當前生命值在法術持續時間內提升。
Level 4: +15 Max HP.name: 4環：+15最大HP

Level 2: +5 Max HP.description: 目標的最大生命值和當前生命值在法術持續時間內提升。
Level 2: +5 Max HP.name: 2環：+5最大HP

Level 3: +10 Max HP.description: 目標的最大生命值和當前生命值在法術持續時間內提升。
Level 3: +10 Max HP.name: 3環：+10最大HP

Level 9: +40 Max HP.description: 目標的最大生命值和當前生命值在法術持續時間內提升。
Level 9: +40 Max HP.name: 9環：+40最大HP

Alarm.name: 警報術
Alarm.description:
你針對不速之客設置一個警報，指定範圍內的一扇門、一扇窗，或一個邊長不大於20呎的立方區域。直到法術結束前，每當有生物觸碰或進入被保護區域時，都會觸發警報。當你施放法術時，你可以決定哪些生物不會觸發警報，也可以選擇警報方式為聲音警報或精神警報：

【聲音警報】 警報在被保護區域60呎範圍內產生持續10秒的搖鈴聲。

【精神警報】 如果你在被保護區域1哩範圍內，你會在心中收到一陣警報。如果你正在睡覺，這個提示會喚醒你。

Alter Self.name: 變造自身
Alter Self.description:
你變換了自身物理形態。從下列效果選項中選擇其中一項。其效果維持至其持續時間結束，在此期間你可以採取一個魔法動作，在選項間切換。

【水中適應】你長出鰓以及手指間的蹼。你可以在水下呼吸，且獲得等同於你步行速度的游泳速度。

Foundry 註記

由「水中適應」行動所提供的主動效果，會將角色的游泳速度升級為「1」，表示與（步行）速度相同。

【改變外貌】你改變了自己的外貌。你決定自己的外觀，包括你的身高、體重、面容細節、聲音、髮長、膚色、以及其他顯著特徵。你可以讓自己看起來像是其他種族的一員，但你的角色數值並不會因此改變。你不能變成與你有著不同體型大小的生物，且你的基本身體輪廓保持原樣。例如，若你是兩足生物，則你不能使用此法術變為四足生物。在法術持續期間內，你可以採取一個魔法動作以此方法再次改變外貌。

【天生武器】你長出利爪（揮砍）、獠牙（穿刺）、犄角（穿刺）或獸蹄（鈍擊）。當你使用這些新生長的部位進行徒手打擊造成傷害時，其造成1d6括弧內指定類型的傷害，而非造成一般徒手打擊傷害。並且，你以施法屬性調整值進行攻擊檢定和傷害擲骰，而不是使用力量。

Natural Weapon.name: 天生武器
Natural Weapon.description: 當你使用這些新生長的部位進行徒手打擊造成傷害時，其造成1d6點括弧內指定類型的傷害，而非造成一般徒手打擊傷害。而且，你使用施法屬性調整值來進行攻擊檢定和傷害擲骰，而不是使用力量。

Aquatic Adaptation.description: 你可以在水下呼吸，並且獲得等同於步行速度的游泳速度。
Aquatic Adaptation.name: 水中適應

Animal Friendship.name: 化獸為友
Animal Friendship.description:
將施法範圍內一隻你所能看見的野獸作為目標。目標必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則將在法術持續時間內陷入&Reference[charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態。如果你或你的盟友對目標造成傷害，則法術停止。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就可以額外選擇一個野獸作為目標。

Charmed.name: 魅惑
Charmed.description: 目標法術持續時間內陷入&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態。目標承受傷害，或者你進行攻擊檢定、造成傷害、迫使任何人進行豁免檢定，則法術將提前結束。

Animal Messenger.name: 動物信使
Animal Messenger.description:
指定一隻你在射程內所能看見的微型野獸，該野獸必須成功通過一次魅力豁免，否則其將為你傳遞一則訊息（若目標的挑戰等級不是0，則自動通過豁免）。你指定一個你曾造訪過的地點，以及一位符合概略描述的收信人，例如「一個穿著城鎮守衛制服的人」或「一個戴著尖帽的紅髮矮人」。你還要傳達一段不超過二十五個單詞的訊息。野獸會在持續期間內前往指定地點，每24小時行進約25哩，若野獸能飛行則為50哩。

野獸抵達後，會模仿你的溝通方式，將你的訊息傳遞給你所描述的生物。若野獸在法術結束前未能抵達目的地，訊息就會遺失，野獸則返回你施放法術的地點。

【升環法術效應】法術位每比2環高一環，此法術的持續時間就增加48小時。

Carrying Message.name: 傳遞訊息
Carrying Message.description:
野獸會在持續期間內前往指定地點，每24小時行進約25哩，若野獸能飛行則為50哩。

野獸抵達後，會模仿你的溝通方式，將你的訊息傳遞給你所描述的生物。若野獸在法術結束前未能抵達目的地，訊息就會遺失，野獸則返回你施放法術的地點。

Animal Shapes.name: 動物化形
Animal Shapes.description:
Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. Each target shape-shifts into a Large or smaller Beast of your choice that has a Challenge Rating of 4 or lower. You can choose a different form for each target. On later turns, you can take a Magic action to transform the targets again.

A target’s game statistics are replaced by the chosen Beast’s statistics, but the target retains its creature type; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; alignment; ability to communicate; and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The target’s actions are limited by the Beast form’s anatomy, and it can’t cast spells. The target’s equipment melds into the new form, and the target can’t use any of that equipment while in that form.

The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Beast form’s Hit Points. The transformation lasts for the duration for each target, until the target has no Temporary Hit Points, or until the target leaves the form as a Bonus Action.

Animate Dead.name: 活化死屍
Animate Dead.description:
選擇射程內一堆骨骸，或一具中型或小型類人生物的屍體。目標會變成一個不死生物：若你選擇骨骸，則為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobSkeleton00]{骷髏}；若你選擇屍體，則為@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobZombie0000]{喪屍}。

在你的每個回合，你可以採取一個附贈動作，以心靈命令任何你以此法術創造、且位於你60呎內的生物（若你控制多個生物，你可以同時命令其中任何數個，並對每個下達相同的命令）。你決定該生物在其下一個回合採取什麼動作以及如何移動，或者你可以下達籠統的命令，例如守衛某個房間或走廊。若你沒有下達命令，該生物會採取迴避動作，且只會為避開傷害而移動。一旦接獲命令，該生物會持續執行，直到任務完成。

該生物受你控制24小時，之後便不再服從你所下達的任何命令。若要再維持對該生物的控制24小時，你必須在當前的24小時結束前，再次對該生物施放此法術。此法術的這種用法會重新確立你對至多四個你以此法術活化之生物的控制，而不是活化新的生物。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，你就額外活化兩個不死生物，或重新確立對額外兩個不死生物的控制。每個生物都必須來自不同的屍體或骨堆。

Animate Objects.name: 活化物體
Animate Objects.description:
Objects animate at your command. Choose a number of nonmagical objects within range that aren’t being worn or carried, aren’t fixed to a surface, and aren’t Gargantuan. The maximum number of objects is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier; for this number, a Medium or smaller target counts as one object, a Large target counts as two, and a Huge target counts as three.

Each target animates, sprouts legs, and becomes a Construct that uses the Animated Object stat block; this creature is under your control until the spell ends or until it is reduced to 0 Hit Points. Each creature you make with this spell is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative count and takes its turn immediately after yours.

Until the spell ends, you can take a Bonus Action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 500 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one). If you issue no commands, the creature takes the &Reference[Dodge] action and moves only to avoid harm. When the creature drops to 0 Hit Points, it reverts to its object form, and any remaining damage carries over to that form.

【升環法術效應】 The creature’s Slam damage increases by 1d4 (Medium or smaller), 1d6 (Large), or 1d12 (Huge) for each spell slot level above 5.

Animated Object Sizes

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbtaoAnimatedOb]{Tiny}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbsaoAnimatedOb]{Small}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmaoAnimatedOb]{Medium}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phblaoAnimatedOb]{Large}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbhaoAnimatedOb]{Huge}

Antilife Shell.name: 反活物護罩
Antilife Shell.description:
An aura extends from you in a 10-foot Emanation for the duration. The aura prevents creatures other than Constructs and Undead from passing or reaching through it. An affected creature can cast spells or make attacks with Ranged or Reach weapons through the barrier.

If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.

Antimagic Field.name: 反魔法結界
Antimagic Field.description:
An aura of antimagic surrounds you in 10-foot Emanation. No one can cast spells, take Magic actions, or create other magical effects inside the aura, and those things can’t target or otherwise affect anything inside it. Magical properties of magic items don’t work inside the aura or on anything inside it.

Areas of effect created by spells or other magic can’t extend into the aura, and no one can teleport into or out of it or use planar travel there. Portals close temporarily while in the aura.

Ongoing spells, except those cast by an Artifact or a deity, are suppressed in the area. While an effect is suppressed, it doesn’t function, but the time it spends suppressed counts against its duration.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{Dispel Magic} has no effect on the aura, and the auras created by different Antimagic Field spells don’t nullify each other.

Antipathy/Sympathy.name: 嫌惡/共感術
Antipathy/Sympathy.description:
As you cast the spell, choose whether it creates antipathy or sympathy, and target one creature or object that is Huge or smaller. Then specify a kind of creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires. A creature of the chosen kind makes a Wisdom saving throw when it comes within 120 feet of the target. Your choice of antipathy or sympathy determines what happens to a creature when it fails that save:

Antipathy. The creature has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐懼} condition. The Frightened creature must use its movement on its turns to get as far away as possible from the target, moving by the safest route.

Sympathy. The creature has the &Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑} condition. The Charmed creature must use its movement on its turns to get as close as possible to the target, moving by the safest route. If the creature is within 5 feet of the target, the creature can’t willingly move away. If the target damages the Charmed creature, that creature can make a Wisdom saving throw to end the effect, as described below.

Ending the Effect. If the Frightened or Charmed creature ends its turn more than 120 feet away from the target, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is no longer affected by the target. A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which it can be affected again.

Frightened.name: Frightened
Frightened.description:
The creature has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐懼} condition. The Frightened creature must use its movement on its turns to get as far away as possible from the target, moving by the safest route.

Ending the Effect. If the Frightened or Charmed creature ends its turn more than 120 feet away from the target, the creature makes a [[/save ability=wis format=long]]. On a successful save, the creature is no longer affected by the target. A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which it can be affected again.

Charmed.name: Charmed
Charmed.description:
The creature has the &Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑} condition. The Charmed creature must use its movement on its turns to get as close as possible to the target, moving by the safest route. If the creature is within 5 feet of the target, the creature can’t willingly move away. If the target damages the Charmed creature, that creature can make a Wisdom saving throw to end the effect, as described below.

Ending the Effect. If the Frightened or Charmed creature ends its turn more than 120 feet away from the target, the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the creature is no longer affected by the target. A creature that successfully saves against this effect is immune to it for 1 minute, after which it can be affected again.

Arcane Eye.name: 祕法眼
Arcane Eye.description:
你在射程內創造一個隱形且不會受到傷害的魔法眼，在持續期間內漂浮於空中。你透過心靈接收魔法眼傳來的視覺資訊，魔法眼可以看見任何方向，且具有範圍30呎的黑暗視覺。

你可以採取附贈動作，使魔法眼朝任意方向移動至多30呎。固體障礙物會阻擋魔法眼的移動，但魔法眼可以穿過直徑小至1吋的開口。

Arcane Gate.name: 祕法之門
Arcane Gate.description:
You create linked teleportation portals. Choose two Large, unoccupied spaces on the ground that you can see, one space within range and the other one within 10 feet of you. A circular portal opens in each of those spaces and remains for the duration.

The portals are two-dimensional glowing rings filled with mist that blocks sight. They hover inches from the ground and are perpendicular to it.

A portal is open on only one side (you choose which). Anything entering the open side of a portal exits from the open side of the other portal as if the two were adjacent to each other. As a Bonus Action, you can change the facing of the open sides.

Arcane Lock.name: 祕法鎖
Arcane Lock.description: 你觸碰一扇關閉的門、窗、柵門、容器或艙口，並使其在持續期間內被魔法鎖住。這道鎖無法以任何非魔法方式解開。你和你在施法時指定的任何生物，都能無視此鎖來開啟和關閉該物件。你也可以設定一組密語，在該物件5呎內說出密語時，可將其解鎖1分鐘。

Armor of Agathys.name: 艾嘉西斯之鎧
Armor of Agathys.description:
保護性的魔法凝霜環繞在你周圍。你獲得5點臨時生命值。在法術結束前，如果有生物以近戰攻擊命中你，該生物承受5點寒冷傷害 。若你沒有臨時生命值，法術將提前結束。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，臨時生命和寒冷傷害將各增加5點。

Frost Damage.name: 凝霜傷害
Frost Damage.condition: 當一個生物以近戰攻擊命中你時

Arms of Hadar.name: 哈達之臂
Arms of Hadar.description:
呼喚哈達的力量，在自己身上長出觸鬚。每個處於你自身10呎發散區域內的生物進行一次力量豁免。豁免失敗時，目標承受2d6黯蝕傷害，並且直到其下一回合開始前無法採取反應；豁免成功時，目標只承受一半的傷害。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d6。

No Reactions.name: 無法反應
No Reactions.description: 目標直到其下一回合開始前都無法採取反應。

Astral Projection.name: 星界投影
Astral Projection.description:
You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane (the spell ends instantly if you are already on that plane). Each target’s body is left behind in a state of suspended animation; it has the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition, doesn’t need food or air, and doesn’t age.

A target’s astral form resembles its body in almost every way, replicating its game statistics and possessions. The principal difference is the addition of a silvery cord that trails from between the shoulder blades of the astral form. The cord fades from view after 1 foot. If the cord is cut—which happens only when an effect states that it does so—the target’s body and astral form both die.

A target’s astral form can travel through the Astral Plane. The moment an astral form leaves that plane, the target’s body and possessions travel along the silver cord, causing the target to re-enter its body on the new plane.

Any damage or other effects that apply to an astral form have no effect on the target’s body and vice versa. If a target’s body or astral form drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends for that target. The spell ends for all the targets if you take a Magic action to dismiss it.

When the spell ends for a target who isn’t dead, the target reappears in its body and exits the state of suspended animation.

Suspended Animation.name: Suspended Animation
Suspended Animation.description: Each target’s body is left behind in a state of suspended animation; it has the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition, doesn’t need food or air, and doesn’t age.

Augury.name: 卜筮
Augury.description:
你從異界存在處獲得一則預兆，預示你在接下來30分鐘內打算採取的一連串行動的結果。DM會從預兆表中選擇一則預兆。

預兆預示著…
吉好的結果。
凶壞的結果。
吉凶並存結果既有好的方面，也有壞的方面。
無結果並無明顯的好壞之分。

此法術不會考量可能改變結果的其他情況，例如其他法術。

若你在完成一次長休之前不只施放一次此法術，那麼第一次之後的每次施放，都有累積25%的機率得不到任何答案。

Aura of Life.name: 生命靈光
Aura of Life.description: 一道靈光在持續期間內從你身上散發，形成30呎發散區域。在靈光內時，你和你的盟友具有黯蝕抗力，且生命值上限無法被降低。若生命值為0的盟友在靈光內開始其回合，該盟友恢復1點生命值。

Aura of Life.name: 生命靈光
Aura of Life.description: 在靈光內時，你和你的盟友具有黯蝕抗力，且生命值上限無法被降低。若生命值為0的盟友在靈光內開始其回合，該盟友恢復[[/healing 1 type=healing]]{1點生命值}。

Aura of Purity.name: 淨化靈光
Aura of Purity.description: 一道靈光在持續期間內從你身上散發，形成30呎發散區域。在靈光內時，你和你的盟友具有毒素抗力，並且在為避免或結束包含下列狀態的效應所做的豁免中具有優勢：&Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲}、&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}、&Reference[Deafened apply=false]{耳聾}、&Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐慌}、&Reference[Paralyzed apply=false]{麻痺}、&Reference[Poisoned apply=false]{中毒}、&Reference[Stunned apply=false]{震懾}。

在靈光內時，你和你的盟友具有毒素抗力，並且在為避免或結束包含下列狀態的效應所做的豁免中具有優勢：&Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲}、&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}、&Reference[Deafened apply=false]{耳聾}、&Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐慌}、&Reference[Paralyzed apply=false]{麻痺}、&Reference[Poisoned apply=false]{中毒}、&Reference[Stunned apply=false]{震懾}。
Aura of Purity.name: 淨化靈光

Aura of Vitality.name: 活力靈光
Aura of Vitality.description: 一道靈光在持續期間內從你身上散發，形成30呎發散區域。當你創造該靈光，以及在其持續期間每個你的回合開始時，你可以使靈光內的一個生物恢復2d6點生命值。

Awaken.name: 啟蒙術
Awaken.description:
You spend the casting time tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, and then touch the target. The target must be either a Beast or Plant creature with an Intelligence of 3 or less or a natural plant that isn’t a creature. The target gains an Intelligence of 10 and the ability to speak one language you know. If the target is a natural plant, it becomes a Plant creature and gains the ability to move its limbs, roots, vines, creepers, and so forth, and it gains senses similar to a human’s. The DM chooses statistics appropriate for the awakened Plant, such as the statistics for the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.gaSTr7DFZJLmgI2J]{Awakened Shrub} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.UR2gWLFHmFwG7ReH]{Awakened Tree} in the Monster Manual.

The awakened target has the &Reference[Charmed] condition for 30 days or until you or your allies deal damage to it. When that condition ends, the awakened creature chooses its attitude toward you.

Bane.name: 災禍術
Bane.description:
選擇施法範圍內至多三個你所能看見的生物，並迫使其進行一次魅力豁免。法術結束前，每當豁免失敗的目標進行攻擊檢定或豁免檢定時，都必須從擲骰結果中減去1d4。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就可以額外選擇一個生物作為目標。

Bane.name: 災禍術
Bane.description: 每當豁免失敗的目標進行一次攻擊檢定或一次豁免檢定時，必須從擲骰結果中減去1d4。

Banishing Smite.name: 放逐斬
Banishing Smite.description: The target hit by the attack roll takes an extra 5d10 Force damage from the attack. If the attack reduces the target to 50 Hit Points or fewer, the target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

Banished.name: Banished
Banished.description: The target is transported to a harmless demiplane for the duration. While there, the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition. When the spell ends, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

Banishment.name: 放逐術
Banishment.description:
射程內一名你所能看見的生物必須成功通過一次魅力豁免，否則會在持續期間內被傳送到一個無害的半位面。身處該半位面期間，目標陷入&Reference[Incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態。當法術結束時，目標重新出現在其離開的空間；若該空間已被佔據，則出現在最近的未佔據空間。

若目標是異怪、天界、元素、精類或邪魔生物，且此法術持續了1分鐘，目標便不會返回。目標改為被傳送到與其生物類型相關的一個位面（由DM選擇）中的隨機地點。

【升環法術效應】法術位每比原本升一環，你就可以額外指定一名生物作為目標。

Banished.name: 受放逐
Banished.description:
身處該半位面期間，目標陷入&Reference[Incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態。當法術結束時，目標重新出現在其離開的空間；若該空間已被佔據，則出現在最近的未佔據空間。

若目標是異怪、天界、元素、精類或邪魔生物，且此法術持續了1分鐘，目標便不會返回。目標改為被傳送到與其生物類型相關的一個位面（由DM選擇）中的隨機地點。

Barkskin.name: 樹膚術
Barkskin.description: 你觸碰一名自願的生物。直到法術結束前，目標的皮膚會呈現樹皮般的外觀，且若目標的AC低於17，則其AC變為17。

Beacon of Hope.name: 希望信標
Beacon of Hope.description: 選擇射程內任意數量的生物。在持續期間內，每個目標在感知豁免與死亡豁免上具有優勢，且從任何治療中恢復最大可能的生命值。

Hopeful.name: 懷抱希望
Hopeful.description: 目標在感知豁免與死亡豁免上具有優勢，且從任何治療中恢復最大可能的生命值。

Beast Sense.name: 野獸知覺
Beast Sense.description: 你觸碰一隻自願的野獸。在持續期間內，你可以透過該野獸的感官以及你自己的感官來感知周遭。當透過野獸的感官感知時，你也能受益於其所擁有的任何特殊感官。

Befuddlement.name: 摧心術
Befuddlement.description:
You blast the mind of a creature that you can see within range. The target makes an Intelligence saving throw.

On a failed save, the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can’t cast spells or take the Magic action. At the end of every 30 days, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on a success. The effect can also be ended by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Greater Restoration}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHeal000000]{Heal}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell.

On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only.

Befuddled.description: On a failed save, the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can’t cast spells or take the Magic action. At the end of every 30 days, the target repeats the [[/save ability=wis]] save, ending the effect on a success. The effect can also be ended by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Greater Restoration}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHeal000000]{Heal}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell.
Befuddled.name: Befuddled

Bestow Curse.name: 降咒
Bestow Curse.description:
你觸碰一個生物，該生物必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則在持續期間內受到詛咒。直到詛咒結束前，目標會遭受你所選擇的下列其中一項效應：

  • 選擇一項屬性。目標以該屬性進行的屬性檢定與豁免檢定具有劣勢（詛咒屬性行動）。
  • 目標對你進行的攻擊檢定具有劣勢（詛咒攻擊行動）。
  • 在戰鬥中，目標必須在其每個回合開始時成功通過一次感知豁免，否則在該回合被迫採取&Reference[Dodge]{迴避}動作（詛咒動作行動）。
  • 若你以攻擊檢定或法術對目標造成傷害，目標會額外承受1d8黯蝕傷害（詛咒韌性行動）。

【升環法術效應】若你使用4環法術位施放此法術，你可以維持專注至多10分鐘。若你使用5環或更高的法術位，此法術不需要專注，且持續時間變為8小時（5至6環法術位）或24小時（7至8環法術位）。若你使用9環法術位，此法術會持續到被解除為止。

Cursed Charisma.name: 魅力受詛
Cursed Charisma.description: 目標以所選屬性進行的屬性檢定與豁免檢定具有劣勢。

Cursed Strength.name: 力量受詛
Cursed Strength.description: 目標以所選屬性進行的屬性檢定與豁免檢定具有劣勢。

Cursed Wisdom.description: 目標以所選屬性進行的屬性檢定與豁免檢定具有劣勢。
Cursed Wisdom.name: 感知受詛

Cursed Constitution.description: 目標以所選屬性進行的屬性檢定與豁免檢定具有劣勢。
Cursed Constitution.name: 體質受詛

Cursed Attacks.name: 攻擊受詛
Cursed Attacks.description: 目標對你進行的攻擊檢定具有劣勢。

Cursed Dexterity.description: 目標以所選屬性進行的屬性檢定與豁免檢定具有劣勢。
Cursed Dexterity.name: 敏捷受詛

Cursed Actions.description: 在戰鬥中，目標必須在其每個回合開始時成功通過一次[[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spell.dc format=long]]，否則在該回合被迫採取&Reference[Dodge]{迴避}動作。
Cursed Actions.name: 動作受詛

Cursed Resilience.description: 若你以攻擊檢定或法術對目標造成傷害，目標會額外承受[[/damage 1d8 type=necrotic]]傷害。
Cursed Resilience.name: 韌性受詛

Cursed Intelligence.name: 智力受詛
Cursed Intelligence.description: 目標以所選屬性進行的屬性檢定與豁免檢定具有劣勢。

Bigby's Hand.name: 畢格比之掌
Bigby's Hand.description:
You create a Large hand of shimmering magical energy in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand lasts for the duration, and it moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand.

The hand is an object that has AC 20 and Hit Points equal to your Hit Point maximum. If it drops to 0 Hit Points, the spell ends. The hand doesn’t occupy its space.

When you cast the spell and as a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can move the hand up to 60 feet and then cause one of the following effects:

Clenched Fist @Embed[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbsplBigbysHand.Item.phbaoiClenchedFi inline]

Forceful Hand @Embed[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbsplBigbysHand.Item.phbaoiForcefulHa inline]

Grasping Hand @Embed[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbsplBigbysHand.Item.phbaoiGraspingHa inline classes="no-secrets"]

Interposing Hand @Embed[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbsplBigbysHand.Item.phbaoiInterposin inline]

【升環法術效應】 The damage of the Clenched Fist increases by 2d8 and the damage of the Grasping Hand increases by 2d6 for each spell slot level above 5.

Blade Barrier.name: 劍刃障壁
Blade Barrier.description:
You create a wall of whirling blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides Three-Quarters Cover, and its space is Difficult Terrain.

Any creature in the wall’s space makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d10 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature also makes that save if it enters the wall’s space or ends it turn there. A creature makes that save only once per turn.

Blade Ward.name: 劍刃防護
Blade Ward.description: 法術結束前，每當一個生物對你進行攻擊檢定時，攻擊者的攻擊檢定中減少1d4。

Bless.name: 祝福術
Bless.description:
你祝福法術範圍內至多三個生物。在法術結束前，每當目標進行攻擊檢定或豁免檢定時，都可以在其中加上1d4。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就可以額外選擇一個生物。

Blessed.name: 祝福
Blessed.description: 每當目標進行攻擊檢定或豁免檢定時，可以在其中加上1d4。

Blight.name: 枯萎術
Blight.description:
射程內一名你所能看見的生物進行一次體質豁免，豁免失敗時承受8d8黯蝕傷害，成功時傷害減半。植物生物在此豁免中自動失敗。

你也可以改為指定一株並非生物的非魔法植物為目標，例如樹木或灌木。該植物不進行豁免，而是直接枯萎死亡。

【升環法術效應】法術位每比原本升一環，傷害就增加1d8。

Arcane Vigor.name: 祕法活力
Arcane Vigor.description:
你利用自己的生命力來治癒自身。投擲一枚或兩枚你尚未消耗的生命骰，然後恢復等同於擲骰總和加上你的施法屬性調整值的生命值。這些生命骰隨後會被消耗。

【升環法術效應】法術位每比2環高一環，你可投擲的未消耗生命骰數量就增加一枚。

Foundry 註記

「消耗dN生命骰」行動被設定為至少消耗2枚生命骰，且只加一次你的調整值。

若想只消耗一枚生命骰，請手動扣除、擲骰並治療。

Shocking Grasp.description:
閃電從你身上射向你想觸碰的生物。對目標發動近戰法術攻擊。命中時，目標承受1d8閃電傷害，且直到其下回合開始前無法發動藉機攻擊。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d8、11級3d8、17級4d8。
Shocking Grasp.name: 電爪

Shocked.name: 觸電
Shocked.description: 直到目標下回合開始前無法發動藉機攻擊。

Sunburst.description:
Brilliant sunlight flashes in a 60-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 12d6 Radiant damage and has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

A creature Blinded by this spell makes another [[/save ability=con dc=@attributes.spelldc format=long]] at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

This spell dispels &Reference[Darkness] in its area that was created by any spell.
Sunburst.name: 陽炎爆

Blinded.name: Blinded
Blinded.description: A creature &Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲} by this spell makes another [[/save ability=con format=long]] at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Blinding Smite.name: 致盲斬
Blinding Smite.description:
被該次打擊命中的目標從該次攻擊中承受額外的3d8光耀傷害，且目標直到法術結束前陷入&Reference[blinded apply=false]{目盲}狀態。目盲的目標在其每個回合結束時進行一次[[/save ability=con dc=@attributes.spell.dc format=long]]，成功則終止其身上的法術。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，額外傷害就增加1d8。

Blinded.description: 目標直到法術結束前陷入目盲狀態。目盲的目標在其每個回合結束時進行一次[[/save ability=con]]豁免，成功則終止其身上的法術。
Blinded.name: 目盲

Blindness/Deafness.name: 目盲/耳聾術
Blindness/Deafness.description:
射程內一個你所能看見的生物必須成功通過一次體質豁免，否則在持續期間內其將陷入&Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲}或&Reference[Deafened apply=false]{耳聾}狀態（由你選擇）。在目標每回合結束時，其重複豁免，成功時結束自己身上的法術。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就可以額外選擇一個生物。

Blindness.name: 目盲
Blindness.description: 在目標每回合結束時，其重複[[/save ability=con]]豁免，成功時結束自己身上的法術。

Deafness.description: 在目標每回合結束時，其重複[[/save ability=con]]豁免，成功時結束自己身上的法術。
Deafness.name: 耳聾

Blink.name: 閃現術
Blink.description:
在持續期間內，你每個回合結束時[[/r 1d6]]{擲1d6}。若擲出4–6，你會從目前所在的存在位面消失，並出現在乙太位面（若你已在該位面，法術會立即結束）。身處乙太位面時，你能感知你離開的那個位面，其景象呈現為灰階，但你無法看見那裡超過60呎外的任何事物。你只能影響乙太位面上的其他生物，也只會受其影響；而另一位面的生物無法感知你，除非其擁有能感知乙太位面事物的特殊能力。

若你身處乙太位面，則會在你的下一個回合開始以及法術結束時，返回另一個位面。你會出現在你所離開之空間10呎內一處你所選擇且你所能看見的未佔據空間；若該範圍內沒有未佔據的空間，你會出現在最近的未佔據空間。

Blur.name: 朦朧術
Blur.description: 你的身體變得模糊不定。在持續期間內，任何生物對你進行的攻擊檢定都具有劣勢。若攻擊者能以&Reference[blindsight]{盲視}或&Reference[truesight]{真視}感知你，則對此效應免疫。

Blurred.name: 模糊
Blurred.description: 在持續期間內，任何生物對你進行的攻擊檢定都具有劣勢。若攻擊者能以盲視或真視感知你，則對此效應免疫。

Burning Hands.name: 燃燒之手
Burning Hands.description:
一道薄薄的火焰帷幕在你身前噴出。每個處於15呎錐形區域內的生物進行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失敗承受3d6火焰傷害，豁免成功則傷害減半。

該法術將點燃範圍內未被穿著或攜帶的可燃物。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，法術的傷害就增加1d6。

Call Lightning.name: 召雷術
Call Lightning.description:
一朵風暴雲出現在射程內你所能看見且位於你上方的一點，其形狀為高10呎、半徑60呎的圓柱體。

當你施放該法術時，選擇雲下方一個你所能看見的點。一道閃電從雲中射向該點。該點5呎內的每個生物都進行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失敗時承受3d10閃電傷害，成功時傷害減半。

直到法術結束前，你可以採取一個魔法動作，以同樣的方式再次召下閃電，目標可以是同一點或另一點。

若你施放此法術時身處戶外的風暴中，此法術會讓你取得該風暴的控制權，而不是創造新的風暴。在這種情況下，法術傷害增加1d10。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d10。

save.chatFlavor: 閃電擊中雲下一點，半徑5呎範圍

Calm Emotions.name: 安定心神
Calm Emotions.description:
你選擇射程內一點，以該點為中心的半徑20呎球形區域內的每個類人生物，都必須成功通過一次魅力豁免，否則會受到下列效果之一影響（由你為每個生物分別選擇）：

  • 直到法術結束前，該生物對魅惑和恐慌狀態免疫。若該生物已經處於魅惑或恐慌狀態，則這些狀態在持續期間內被壓制。
  • 該生物對你所選擇、原本對其懷有敵意的生物，態度變為冷漠。此冷漠在目標受到傷害，或目睹其盟友受到傷害時結束。當法術結束時，該生物的態度恢復正常。

Calmed.description: 直到法術結束前，該生物對魅惑和恐慌狀態免疫。若該生物已經處於魅惑或恐慌狀態，則這些狀態在持續期間內被壓制。
Calmed.name: 平靜

Indifference.name: 冷漠
Indifference.description: 該生物對你所選擇、原本對其懷有敵意的生物，態度變為冷漠。此冷漠在目標受到傷害，或目睹其盟友受到傷害時結束。當法術結束時，該生物的態度恢復正常。

Chain Lightning.name: 連環閃電
Chain Lightning.description:
You launch a lightning bolt toward a target you can see within range. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets of your choice, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target. A target can be a creature or an object and can be targeted by only one of the bolts.

Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d8 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

【升環法術效應】 One additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target for each spell slot level above 6.

Charm Monster.name: 魅惑怪物
Charm Monster.description:
射程內一名你所能看見的生物進行一次感知豁免。若你或你的盟友正在與其戰鬥，其進行該豁免時具有優勢。豁免失敗時，直到法術結束前，或者直到你或你的盟友對其造成傷害前，目標陷入&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態。被魅惑的生物對你是友好的。當法術結束時，目標會知道曾被你魅惑。

【升環法術效應】法術位每比原本升一環，你就可以額外指定一名生物作為目標。

Charmed.name: 魅惑
Charmed.description: 直到法術結束前，或者直到你或你的盟友對其造成傷害前，目標陷入&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態。被魅惑的生物對你是友好的。當法術結束時，目標會知道曾被你魅惑。

Charm Person.name: 魅惑人類
Charm Person.description:
法術範圍內你所能看見的一個累人生物進行一次感知豁免。如果你或你的盟友正在與其戰鬥，其進行豁免檢定時具有優勢。豁免失敗時，直到法術結束前，或者直到你或你的盟友對其造成傷害前，目標陷入&Reference[charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態。被魅惑的生物對你是友好的。當法術結束時，目標會知道曾被你魅惑。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就可以額外選擇一個生物。

Charmed.name: 魅惑
Charmed.description: 直到法術結束前，或者直到你或你的盟友對其造成傷害前，目標陷入&Reference[charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態。被魅惑的生物對你是友好的。當法術結束時，目標會知道曾被你魅惑。

Chill Touch.name: 寒顫之觸
Chill Touch.description:
引導墳墓的刺骨凍寒，對觸及範圍內的一個目標進行一次近戰法術攻擊。命中時，目標承受1d10黯蝕傷害，並且直到你的下一回合結束前不能恢復生命值。

【戲法升級】 當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d10、11級3d10、17級4d10。

Blocked Healing.description: 直到你的下一個回合結束前，目標無法恢復生命值。
Blocked Healing.name: 治療受阻

Chromatic Orb.name: 幻色法球
Chromatic Orb.description:
你將一個能量球投向法術範圍內的一個目標。從強酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電、毒素、雷鳴中選擇一種作為你創造之球體的傷害類型，並對該目標進行一次遠程法術攻擊。命中時，目標承受3d8你所選類型的傷害。

若有兩個或更多的d8擲出相同的數字，能量球將跳躍至距離目標30呎內，你所選擇的另一個目標上。對新的目標進行一次攻擊檢定，並擲一次新的傷害骰。除非你使用2環以上的法術位施放該法術，否則能量球將不再跳轉。[[@item.level]]{跳躍次數}

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害將再增加1d8。能量球最多可以跳躍的次數等同於所消耗的法術位環階，並且每次施放此法術時，同一個生物只能被選為目標一次。

Circle of Death.name: 死亡之環
Circle of Death.description:
Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius Sphere from a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

【升環法術效應】 The damage increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 6.

Circle of Power.name: 威能法環
Circle of Power.description: An aura radiates from you in a 30-foot Emanation for the duration. While in the aura, you and your allies have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. When an affected creature makes a saving throw against a spell or magical effect that allows a save to take only half damage, it takes no damage if it succeeds on the save.

Clairvoyance.name: 銳眼術
Clairvoyance.description:
你在射程內一處你熟悉的地點（你曾造訪或見過的地方），或一個顯而易見但你不熟悉的地點（例如門後、轉角處或樹林中），創造一個隱形的感測器。這個無形且無法傷害的感測器會在持續期間內留在原處。

當你施放法術時，選擇視覺或聽覺。你可以透過感測器使用所選的感官，如同你位於其所在空間。你可以用一個附贈動作在視覺與聽覺之間切換。

看見感測器的生物（例如受益於識破隱形或&Reference[truesight]{真視}的生物）會看見一顆約拳頭大小的發光球體。

Clone.name: 克隆術
Clone.description:
You touch a creature or at least 1 cubic inch of its flesh. An inert duplicate of that creature forms inside the vessel used in the spell’s casting and finishes growing after 120 days; you choose whether the finished clone is the same age as the creature or younger. The clone remains inert and endures indefinitely while its vessel remains undisturbed.

If the original creature dies after the clone finishes forming, the creature’s soul transfers to the clone if the soul is free and willing to return. The clone is physically identical to the original and has the same personality, memories, and abilities, but none of the original’s equipment. The creature’s original remains, if any, become inert and can’t be revived, since the creature’s soul is elsewhere.

Cloudkill.name: 死雲術
Cloudkill.description:
You create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of yellow-green fog centered on a point within range. The fog lasts for the duration or until strong wind (such as the one created by Gust of Wind) disperses it, ending the spell. Its area is Heavily Obscured.

Each creature in the Sphere makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d8 Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature must also make this save when the Sphere moves into its space and when it enters the Sphere or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

The Sphere moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

【升環法術效應】 The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

Color Spray.name: 七彩噴射
Color Spray.description: 你釋放出一束束耀眼的七彩光芒。每個處於你自身15呎錐形區域內的生物必須成功通過一次體質豁免，否則直到你下回合結束前，將陷入&Reference[blinded apply=false]{目盲}狀態。

Command.name: 命令術
Command.description:
你對法術範圍內一名你所能看見的生物說出一個單詞的指令。目標必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則在其下一回合必須遵從你的指令。從下列選項中選擇指令：

【過來】 目標將沿著最短且最直接的路徑向你移動，在抵達你5呎內時結束其回合。

【放下】 目標將丟掉手中持有的物品，然後結束其回合。

【滾】目標在其回合中以最快的方式遠離你。

【趴下】 目標陷入伏地狀態並結束其回合。

【站住】 在其回合中，目標既不移動也不採取任何動作或附贈動作。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就可以額外影響一個生物。

Commune.name: 通神術
Commune.description:
You contact a deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. You receive a correct answer for each question.

Divine beings aren’t necessarily omniscient, so you might receive “unclear” as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity’s knowledge. In a case where a one-word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity’s interests, the DM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead.

If you cast the spell more than once before finishing a Long Rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer.

Commune with Nature.name: 問道自然
Commune with Nature.description:
You commune with nature spirits and gain knowledge of the surrounding area. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the area within 3 miles of you. In caves and other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet. The spell doesn’t function where nature has been replaced by construction, such as in castles and settlements.

Choose three of the following facts; you learn those facts as they pertain to the spell’s area:

  • Locations of settlements
  • Locations of portals to other planes of existence
  • Location of one Challenge Rating 10+ creature (DM’s choice) that is a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, a Fiend, or an Undead
  • The most prevalent kind of plant, mineral, or Beast (you choose which to learn)
  • Locations of bodies of water

For example, you could determine the location of a powerful monster in the area, the locations of bodies of water, and the locations of any towns.

Compelled Duel.name: 強迫決鬥
Compelled Duel.description:
你嘗試迫使一個生物與你決鬥。法術範圍內一名你所能看見的生物進行一次感知豁免。豁免失敗時，目標的攻擊檢定對你以外的生物具有劣勢，且不能主動移動到距離你30呎以外的區域。

當你對目標以外的生物進行攻擊檢定、或對目標以外的敵人施法、或你的盟友對目標造成傷害、抑或是你回合結束時與目標的距離超過30呎，該法術結束。

Compelled.name: 強迫決鬥
Compelled.description: 目標的攻擊檢定對你以外的生物具有劣勢，且不能主動移動到距離你30呎以外的空間。

Comprehend Languages.name: 通曉語言
Comprehend Languages.description: 法術持續時間內，你能理解你所聽到的任何語言或你所看到的任何手語的字面意思。你也能讀懂任何你看見的書面語言，但必須觸摸寫有文字的表面，閱讀一頁文本大約需要1分鐘。此法術無法解讀符文或秘密資訊。

Compulsion.name: 強迫術
Compulsion.description:
射程內每個你所選擇且你所能看見的生物，必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則直到法術結束前陷入魅惑狀態。

在持續期間內，你可以採取附贈動作，指定與你同一水平面上的一個方向。每個陷入&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態的目標，必須在其下一個回合採取最安全的路線，使用盡可能多的移動距離向該方向前進。以此方式移動後，目標重複該豁免，成功時目標身上的法術結束。

Charmed.name: 魅惑
Charmed.description: 你可以採取附贈動作，指定與你同一水平面上的一個方向。每個陷入&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態的目標，必須在其下一個回合採取最安全的路線，使用盡可能多的移動距離向該方向前進。以此方式移動後，目標重複該[[/save ability=wis]]豁免，成功時目標身上的法術結束。

Cone of Cold.name: 寒冰錐
Cone of Cold.description:
You unleash a blast of cold air. Each creature in a 60-foot Cone originating from you makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.

【升環法術效應】 The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

Confusion.name: 困惑術
Confusion.description:
以射程內你所選擇的一點為中心，半徑10呎球形區域內的每名生物必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則目標無法採取附贈動作或反應，且必須在其每個回合開始時擲1d10，參照下表決定該回合的行為。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.tables.RollTable.phbsplConfusionB rollable cite=false classes="caption-top"]{本回合行為}

在受影響目標的每個回合結束時，該目標重複該豁免，成功時目標身上的法術結束。

【升環法術效應】法術位每比原本升一環，球形區域的半徑就增加5呎。

Confused.name: 困惑
Confused.description:
目標無法採取附贈動作或反應，且必須在其每個回合開始時擲1d10，參照下表決定該回合的行為。

@Embed[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.tables.RollTable.phbsplConfusionB rollable cite=false classes="caption-top"]{本回合行為}

在受影響目標的每個回合結束時，該目標重複該[[/save ability=wis]]豁免，成功時目標身上的法術結束。

Conjure Animals.name: 召喚動物
Conjure Animals.description:
你召喚自然靈魂，其以一群大型、無實體的幽靈動物之姿，出現在射程內一處你所能看見的未佔據空間。這群動物在持續期間內存在，並由你選擇靈魂的動物形態，例如狼、蛇或鳥。

當你位於獸群5呎內時，你的力量豁免具有優勢；而當你在自己的回合移動時，也可以將獸群移動至多30呎到一處你所能看見的未佔據空間。

每當獸群移動到你所能看見的某個生物10呎內，以及每當你所能看見的生物進入獸群10呎內的空間或在該處結束其回合時，你可以迫使該生物進行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失敗時，該生物承受3d10揮砍傷害。生物每回合只會進行一次此豁免。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d10。

Conjure Barrage.name: 召喚箭幕
Conjure Barrage.description:
你揮舞用來施放法術的武器，召喚出相似的靈體武器（或適合該武器的彈藥），向前射出後隨即消失。位於你所能看見的60呎錐形區域內每個你所選擇的生物都進行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失敗時承受5d8力場傷害，成功時傷害減半。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d8。

Conjure Celestial.name: 召喚天界生物
Conjure Celestial.description:
You conjure a spirit from the Upper Planes, which manifests as a pillar of light in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder centered on a point within range. For each creature you can see in the Cylinder, choose which of these lights shines on it:

Healing Light. The target regains Hit Points equal to 4d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier.

Searing Light. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 6d12 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Until the spell ends, Bright Light fills the Cylinder, and when you move on your turn, you can also move the Cylinder up to 30 feet.

Whenever the Cylinder moves into the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Cylinder or ends its turn there, you can bathe it in one of the lights. A creature can be affected by this spell only once per turn.

【升環法術效應】 The healing and damage increase by 1d12 for each spell slot level above 7.

Conjure Elemental.name: 召喚元素生物
Conjure Elemental.description:
You conjure a Large, intangible spirit from the Elemental Planes that appears in an unoccupied space within range. Choose the spirit’s element, which determines its damage type: @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbsplConjuredEl]{air (Lightning)}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbConjuredEarth]{earth (Thunder)}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbConjuredFireE]{fire (Fire)}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbConjuredWater]{water (Cold)}. The spirit lasts for the duration.

Whenever a creature you can see enters the spirit’s space or starts its turn within 5 feet of the spirit, you can force that creature to make a Dexterity saving throw if the spirit has no creature Restrained. On failed save, the target takes 8d8 damage of the spirit’s type, and the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition until the spell ends. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target repeats the save. On a failed save, the target takes 4d8 damage of the spirit’s type. On a successful save, the target isn’t Restrained by the spirit.

【升環法術效應】 The damage increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

Conjure Fey.name: 召喚精類生物
Conjure Fey.description:
You conjure a Medium spirit from the Feywild in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The spirit lasts for the duration, and it looks like a Fey creature of your choice. When the spirit appears, you can make one melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes Psychic damage equal to 3d12 plus your spellcasting ability modifier, and the target has the &Reference[Frightened] condition until the start of your next turn, with both you and the spirit as the source of the fear.

As a Bonus Action on your later turns, you can teleport the spirit to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of the space it left and make the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

【升環法術效應】 The damage increases by 2d12 for each spell slot level above 6.

Conjure Minor Elementals.name: 召喚次級元素生物
Conjure Minor Elementals.description:
你召喚來自元素位面的精魂，在持續期間內於你周圍15呎發散區域中飛舞。直到法術結束前，你所做的任何攻擊命中發散區域內的生物時，都會額外造成2d8傷害。此傷害為強酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電傷害（在你進行該次攻擊時選擇）。

此外，發散區域內的地面對你的敵人而言是&Reference[DifficultTerrain]{困難地形}。

【升環法術效應】法術位每比原本升一環，傷害就增加1d8。

Conjure Volley.name: 召喚箭雨
Conjure Volley.description: You brandish the weapon used to cast the spell and choose a point within range. Hundreds of similar spectral weapons (or ammunition appropriate to the weapon) fall in a volley and then disappear. Each creature of your choice that you can see in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high Cylinder centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d8 Force damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Conjure Woodland Beings.name: 召喚林地之精
Conjure Woodland Beings.description:
你召喚自然精魂，在持續期間內於你周圍10呎發散區域中飛舞。每當發散區域進入你所能看見的一名生物所在的空間，以及每當你所能看見的生物進入發散區域或在該處結束其回合時，你可以迫使該生物進行一次感知豁免。豁免失敗時，該生物承受5d8力場傷害，成功時傷害減半。生物每回合只會進行一次此豁免。

此外，在法術的持續期間內，你可以採取附贈動作來採取&Reference[Disengage]{撤離}動作。

【升環法術效應】法術位每比原本升一環，傷害就增加1d8。

Contact Other Plane.name: 異界探知
Contact Other Plane.description:
You mentally contact a demigod, the spirit of a long-dead sage, or some other knowledgeable entity from another plane. Contacting this otherworldly intelligence can break your mind. When you cast this spell, make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a successful save, you can ask the entity up to five questions. You must ask your questions before the spell ends. The DM answers each question with one word, such as “yes,” “no,” “maybe,” “never,” “irrelevant,” or “unclear” (if the entity doesn’t know the answer to the question). If a one-word answer would be misleading, the DM might instead offer a short phrase as an answer.

On a failed save, you take 6d6 Psychic damage and have the &Reference[Incapacitated] condition until you finish a Long Rest. A @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Greater Restoration} spell cast on you ends this effect.

Contagion.name: 疫病術
Contagion.description:
Your touch inflicts a magical contagion. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 11d8 Necrotic damage and have the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition. Also, choose one ability when you cast the spell. While Poisoned, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws made with the chosen ability.

The target must repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or failures. If the target succeeds on three of these saves, the spell ends on the target. If the target fails three of the saves, the spell lasts for 7 days on it.

Whenever the Poisoned target receives an effect that would end the Poisoned condition, the target must succeed on a [[/save ability=con dc=@attributes.spelldc format=long]], or the Poisoned condition doesn’t end on it.

Infected (Strength).name: Infected (Strength)
Infected (Strength).description:
• While &Reference[Poisoned apply=false], the target has Disadvantage on saving throws made with the chosen ability.

  • The target must repeat the [[/save ability=con format=long]] at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or failures.

  • Whenever the target receives an effect that would end the Poisoned condition, the target must succeed on a [[/save ability=con format=long]], or the condition doesn’t end on it.

Infected (Dexterity).name: Infected (Dexterity)
Infected (Dexterity).description:
• While &Reference[Poisoned apply=false], the target has Disadvantage on saving throws made with the chosen ability.

  • The target must repeat the [[/save ability=con format=long]] at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or failures.

  • Whenever the target receives an effect that would end the Poisoned condition, the target must succeed on a [[/save ability=con format=long]], or the condition doesn’t end on it.

Infected (Constitution).name: Infected (Constitution)
Infected (Constitution).description:
• While &Reference[Poisoned apply=false], the target has Disadvantage on saving throws made with the chosen ability.

  • The target must repeat the [[/save ability=con format=long]] at the end of each of its turns until it gets three successes or failures.

  • Whenever the target receives an effect that would end the Poisoned condition, the target must succeed on a [[/save ability=con format=long]], or the condition doesn’t end on it.

  • Whenever the target receives an effect that would end the Poisoned condition, the target must succeed on a [[/save ability=con format=long]], or the condition doesn’t end on it.

Contingency.name: 觸發術
Contingency.description:
Choose a spell of level 5 or lower that you can cast, that has a casting time of an action, and that can target you. You cast that spell—called the contingent spell—as part of casting Contingency, expending spell slots for both, but the contingent spell doesn’t come into effect. Instead, it takes effect when a certain trigger occurs. You describe that trigger when you cast the two spells. For example, a Contingency cast with Water Breathing might stipulate that Water Breathing comes into effect when you are engulfed in water or a similar liquid.

The contingent spell takes effect immediately after the trigger occurs for the first time, whether or not you want it to, and then Contingency ends.

The contingent spell takes effect only on you, even if it can normally target others. You can use only one Contingency spell at a time. If you cast this spell again, the effect of another Contingency spell on you ends. Also, Contingency ends on you if its material component is ever not on your person.

Foundry Note

The "create contingency" activity is configured to optionally enchant a Scroll to track and serve as the triggered spell. Create a spell scroll by right clicking on a spell in your spell list, expend a spell slot of the created scroll's level, and enchant the scroll.

Continual Flame.name: 不滅明焰
Continual Flame.description: 一束火焰從你觸碰的物體上冒出。這個效果發出半徑20呎的&Reference[brightlight]{明亮光照}，並延伸出20呎的&Reference[dimlight]{微光}。其看起來像普通的火焰，但不產生熱量，也不消耗燃料。火焰可以被遮蓋或隱藏，但不能被悶熄或澆滅。

Control Water.name: 操控水體
Control Water.description:
直到法術結束前，你控制所選區域內的任何水體，並使用下列其中一種效應。該區域為邊長至多100呎的立方體。在你之後的回合，你可以採取魔法動作，重複同一效應或選擇另一種效應。

【上漲】你使區域內所有靜止水體的水位上漲至多20呎。若你選擇的區域位於一片大型水體中，則改為創造一道20呎高的波浪，從區域的一側移向另一側後潰散。波浪路徑中任何巨型或更小的載具都會被帶到另一側。被波浪擊中的任何巨型或更小載具都有[[/r 1d100cs<26#Vehicle is capsized]]{25%}的機率傾覆。

直到法術結束前，或你選擇另一種效應前，水位維持上漲。若此效應產生了波浪，則在上漲效應持續期間，波浪會在你的下一個回合開始時再次出現。

【分水】你使區域內的水體分開，形成一道水中溝壑。溝壑橫跨法術區域，被分開的水體在兩側各形成一道水牆。直到法術結束前，或你選擇另一種效應前，溝壑持續存在。隨後，水流會在下一輪內緩慢填滿溝壑，直到恢復正常水位。

【轉向】你使區域內的流水朝你所選擇的方向流動，即使水流必須越過障礙物、沿牆向上或流向其他不尋常的方向。區域內的水體依你的指示移動，但離開法術區域後，便恢復依地形流動。直到法術結束前，或你選擇另一種效應前，水體持續朝你所選擇的方向流動。

【漩渦】你使區域中央形成一道漩渦，該區域必須至少為邊長50呎的正方形，且至少25呎深。直到你選擇另一種效應前，或法術結束前，漩渦持續存在。漩渦底部寬5呎，頂部寬至多50呎，高25呎。任何位於水中且在漩渦25呎內的生物，都會被朝漩渦拉近10呎。當一名生物在一個回合內首次進入漩渦，或在漩渦內結束其回合時，其進行一次力量豁免。豁免失敗時，該生物承受2d8鈍擊傷害；成功時傷害減半。生物只有先採取動作掙脫，並成功通過一次對抗你法術豁免DC的[[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spell.dc]]檢定，才能游離漩渦。

Control Weather.name: 操控天氣
Control Weather.description:
You take control of the weather within 5 miles of you for the duration. You must be outdoors to cast this spell, and it ends early if you go indoors.

When you cast the spell, you change the current weather conditions, which are determined by the DM. You can change precipitation, temperature, and wind. It takes 1d4 × 10 minutes for the new conditions to take effect. Once they do so, you can change the conditions again. When the spell ends, the weather gradually returns to normal.

When you change the weather conditions, find a current condition on the following tables and change its stage by one, up or down. When changing the wind, you can change its direction.

Precipitation
StageCondition
1Clear
2Light clouds
3Overcast or ground fog
4Rain, hail, or snow
5Torrential rain, driving hail, or blizzard
Temperature
StageCondition
1Heat wave
2Hot
3Warm
4Cool
5Cold
6Freezing
Wind
StageCondition
1Calm
2Moderate wind
3Strong wind
4Gale
5Storm

Holy Aura.description: For the duration, you emit an aura in a 30-foot Emanation. While in the aura, creatures of your choice have Advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have Disadvantage on attack rolls against them. In addition, when a Fiend or an Undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack roll, the attacker must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the &Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲} condition until the end of its next turn.
Holy Aura.name: 神聖靈光

Blinded.description: The attacker has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲} condition until the end of its next turn.
Blinded.name: Blinded

Hunger of Hadar.description:
你打開一道通往遙遠國度的通道，那是一片充斥著難以言喻之恐怖的區域。以射程內一點為中心，會出現一個半徑20呎的&Reference[Darkness]{黑暗}球形區域，並在持續期間內存在。該球形區域為&Reference[DifficultTerrain]{困難地形}，其中充滿奇異的低語與啜吸聲，30呎外仍可聽見。任何光線，無論是魔法光線或其他光線，都無法照亮該區域，完全位於其中的生物陷入&Reference[Blinded]{目盲}狀態。

任何在區域內開始其回合的生物承受2d6寒冷傷害。任何在區域內結束其回合的生物必須成功通過一次敏捷豁免，否則承受來自異界觸手的2d6強酸傷害。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，寒冷或強酸傷害（由你選擇）就增加1d6。
Hunger of Hadar.name: 哈達之欲

Cordon of Arrows.name: 警戒箭陣
Cordon of Arrows.description:
你觸碰至多四枚非魔法的箭矢或弩矢，並將其插在你所處空間的地面上。直到法術結束前，這些彈藥無法被以物理方式拔起；每當除你以外的生物於一回合內首次進入距該彈藥30呎內的空間，或在該範圍內結束其回合時，就會有一枚彈藥飛起對其發起攻擊。該生物必須成功通過一次敏捷豁免，否則受到2d4點穿刺傷害，該枚彈藥隨後被摧毀。當沒有任何彈藥插在地面上時，法術結束。

當你施放該法術時，你可以指定任何你選擇的生物，法術會無視於其。

【升環法術效應】法術位每比2環高一環，可受影響的彈藥數量就增加兩枚。

Foundry 註記

「施放」行動會依受影響且可由「豁免」行動射出的彈藥數量，重置此物品的有限使用次數。

Counterspell.name: 反制法術
Counterspell.description: 你試圖打斷一個正在施放法術的生物。該生物進行一次體質豁免。豁免失敗時，法術消散且沒有任何效果，用來施放該法術的動作、附贈動作或反應也會被浪費。若該法術是以法術位施放的，則不會消耗該法術位。

Create Food and Water.name: 創造飲食
Create Food and Water.description: 你在射程內的地面上或容器中創造45磅食物與30加侖淡水，兩者都有助於抵禦飢餓與脫水的危害。食物味道平淡但營養豐富，外觀是你所選擇的某種食物，水則是乾淨的。食物若24小時內未被食用就會腐壞。

Create or Destroy Water.name: 造水/枯水術
Create or Destroy Water.description:
你可以選擇做以下其中一項：

【造水】你在法術範圍內一個已開封的容器中，創造出至多10加侖的清水，或者使水如雨般落在法術範圍內一處30呎立方區域中，以撲滅那裡暴露的火焰。

【枯水】你在法術範圍內一個已開封的容器中，使至多10加侖的水乾竭，或者使法術範圍內一處30呎立方區域中的霧氣消散。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就可以額外創造或乾竭10加侖的水，或使立方區域邊長增加5呎。

Create Undead.name: 創造不死生物
Create Undead.description:
You can cast this spell only at night. Choose up to three corpses of Medium or Small Humanoids within range. Each one becomes a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.OBujQLLPSmlJiZnL]{Ghoul} under your control (see the Monster Manual for its stat block).

As a Bonus Action on each of your turns, you can mentally command any creature you animated with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any of them at the same time, issuing the same command to them). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move on its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular place. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the &Reference[Dodge] action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow the order until its task is complete.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you’ve given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to three creatures you have animated with this spell rather than animating new ones.

【升環法術效應】If you use a level 7 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over four Ghouls. If you use a level 8 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over five Ghouls or two @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.IyIybE5t2adMEVUM]{Ghasts} or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.rbyp54px2D0ql4QK]{Wights}. If you use a level 9 spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over six Ghouls, three Ghasts or Wights, or two @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.t8WYD7ak07X7xpx8]{Mummies}. See the Monster Manual for these stat blocks.

Creation.name: 造物術
Creation.description:
You pull wisps of shadow material from the Shadowfell to create an object within range. It is either an object of vegetable matter (soft goods, rope, wood, and the like) or mineral matter (stone, crystal, metal, and the like). The object must be no larger than a 5-foot Cube, and the object must be of a form and material that you have seen.

The spell’s duration depends on the object’s material, as shown in the Materials table. If the object is composed of multiple materials, use the shortest duration. Using any object created by this spell as another spell’s Material component causes the other spell to fail.

MaterialDuration
Vegetable matter24 hours
Stone or crystal12 hours
Precious metals1 hour
Gems10 minutes
Adamantine or mithral1 minute

【升環法術效應】 The Cube increases by 5 feet for each spell slot level above 5.

Crown of Madness.name: 瘋狂冠冕
Crown of Madness.description:
射程內一個你所能看見的生物必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則在法術持續時間內陷入魅惑狀態。若其非類人生物則自動成功。

一個靈體的皇冠將出現在被魅惑目標的頭上，且其每個回合必須在移動前，對一個除其自身之外你精神指定的生物進行近戰攻擊。若你未指定生物，或沒有在其觸及範圍內的生物，則目標可以在其回合中正常行動。目標在其每回合結束時重複豁免，並在成功時結束其身上的法術。

在你後續回合中，你必須採取魔法動作維持對目標的控制，否則法術結束。

Spectral Crown.name: 靈體皇冠
Spectral Crown.description: 目標每個回合必須在移動前，對一個除其自身之外你精神指定的生物進行近戰攻擊。若你未指定生物，或沒有在其觸及範圍內的生物，則目標可以在其回合中正常行動。目標在其每回合結束時重複[[/save ability=wis]]豁免，並在成功時結束其身上的法術。

Crusader's Mantle.name: 十字軍斗篷
Crusader's Mantle.description: 你散發出30呎發散區域的魔法靈光。位於靈光內時，你和你的盟友每次以武器或徒手打擊命中時，都會額外造成1d4光耀傷害。

Cure Wounds.name: 治療傷勢
Cure Wounds.description:
一個你所觸碰的生物恢復等同於2d8加上你的施法屬性調整值的生命值。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，治療量將再增加2d8。

Dancing Lights.name: 舞光術
Dancing Lights.description:
你在範圍內創造出至多4團火炬大小的光源，塑造成持續時間內懸浮在空中的火炬、燈籠或發光球體。或者，你可以將這4團光源合併成一個發出光芒的中型人形輪廓。無論你選擇哪種形式，每團光源散發出10呎微光光照。

作為附贈動作，你可以移動整團光源到範圍內至多60呎的空間。一團光源必須在另一個由這個法術創造的光源20尺內，如果超出法術範圍，光源就會消失。

Darkness.name: 黑暗術
Darkness.description:
法術持續時間內，魔法&Reference[darkness]{黑暗}從射程內的一點擴散，並籠罩半徑15呎的球形區域。黑暗視覺無法看透其中，非魔法光源也無法將其照亮。

或者，你可以將法術施放在一個未被穿著或攜帶的物體上，使黑暗填滿以該物體為中心 15 呎的發散區域。用不透明的東西，比如碗或頭盔，覆蓋該物體即可阻擋黑暗。

若此法術的任何區域與一個明亮或微光光照區域重疊，而這個光照區域是由某個2環或更低環階的法術所創造，則那個法術將被解除。

Darkvision.name: 黑暗視覺
Darkvision.description: 在持續期間內，你所觸碰的自願生物擁有範圍150呎的&Reference[darkvision]{黑暗視覺}。
在持續期間內，你所觸碰的自願生物擁有範圍150呎的&Reference[darkvision]{黑暗視覺}。
Darkvision.name: 黑暗視覺

Daylight.name: 晝明術
Daylight.description:
在持續期間內，陽光從射程內一點擴散出來，並充滿半徑60呎的球形區域。陽光所及的區域為明亮光照，並在其外額外60呎範圍內散發微光。

或者，你可以將法術施放在未被穿戴或攜帶的物體上，使陽光充滿以該物體為源頭的60呎發散區域。以不透明的東西（例如碗或頭盔）覆蓋該物體即可阻擋陽光。

若此法術的任何區域與3環或更低環階法術所創造的黑暗區域重疊，則其他法術即被解除。

Death Ward.name: 防死護咒
Death Ward.description:
你觸碰一名生物，給予其一定程度的死亡防護。當目標的生命值在法術結束前首次將降至0時，改為降至1，隨後法術結束。

若目標受到不造成傷害卻會使其立即死亡的效應影響時，此法術仍在生效，則該效應對目標無效，隨後法術結束。

Protection from Death.description:
當目標的生命值在法術結束前首次將降至0時，改為降至1，隨後法術結束。

若目標受到不造成傷害卻會使其立即死亡的效應影響時，此法術仍在生效，則該效應對目標無效，隨後法術結束。
Protection from Death.name: 死亡防護

Delayed Blast Fireball.name: 延遲爆裂火球
Delayed Blast Fireball.description:
A beam of yellow light flashes from you, then condenses at a chosen point within range as a glowing bead for the duration. When the spell ends, the bead explodes, and each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes Fire damage equal to the total accumulated damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

The spell’s base damage is 12d6, and the damage increases by 1d6 whenever your turn ends and the spell hasn’t ended.

If a creature touches the glowing bead before the spell ends, that creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the spell ends, causing the bead to explode. On a successful save, the creature can throw the bead up to 40 feet. If the thrown bead enters a creature’s space or collides with a solid object, the spell ends, and the bead explodes.

When the bead explodes, flammable objects in the explosion that aren’t being worn or carried start burning.

【升環法術效應】 The base damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 7.

Foundry Note

The limited uses value of this spell tracks the number of rounds that have passed since the initial casting and starts at 0.

The Turn End Damage Increase activity will increase that value by 1.

The Trigger Explosion activity calculates the total damage based on the limited uses.

If you would prefer manual tracking, you can use Trigger Explosion's Situational Bonus dialog to add the extra d6s and ignore the Turn End Damage Increase activity.

Touch Bead.name: Touch Bead
Touch Bead.condition: a creature touches the glowing bead before the spell ends

Demiplane.name: 半位面
Demiplane.description:
You create a shadowy Medium door on a flat solid surface that you can see within range. This door can be opened and closed, and it leads to a demiplane that is an empty room 30 feet in each dimension, made of wood or stone (your choice).

When the spell ends, the door vanishes, and any objects inside the demiplane remain there. Any creatures inside also remain unless they opt to be shunted through the door as it vanishes, landing with the &Reference[Prone] condition in the unoccupied spaces closest to the door’s former space.

Each time you cast this spell, you can create a new demiplane or connect the shadowy door to a demiplane you created with a previous casting of this spell. Additionally, if you know the nature and contents of a demiplane created by a casting of this spell by another creature, you can connect the shadowy door to that demiplane instead.

Destructive Wave.name: 湮滅波
Destructive Wave.description: Destructive energy ripples outward from you in a 30-foot Emanation. Each creature you choose in the Emanation makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 5d6 Thunder damage and 5d6 Radiant or Necrotic damage (your choice) and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.

Detect Evil and Good.name: 偵測善惡
Detect Evil and Good.description:
法術持續時間內，你能感知到自身30呎內的任何異怪、天界、元素、精類、邪魔或亡靈生物。你也能感知到這個範圍內是否有@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplHallow0000]{聖居}法術生效，以及若有，其位置何在。

該法術無法穿透1呎厚的石頭、泥土、木頭，1吋厚的金屬或薄薄一層鉛。

Detect Magic.name: 偵測魔法
Detect Magic.description:
法術持續時間內，你感知自身30呎內魔法效應的存在，若你感知到此類效應，你可以採取魔法動作，以看見區域內任何帶有魔法的可見生物或物體周圍的微弱靈光，並且若是由法術所創造的效應，你可以得知該法術的魔法學派。

該法術無法穿透1呎厚的石頭、泥土、木頭，1吋厚的金屬或薄薄一層鉛。

Detect Poison and Disease.name: 偵測毒素或疾病
Detect Poison and Disease.description:
法術持續時間內，你感知自身周圍30尺內的毒素、帶毒或有毒腺的生物、以及魔法疫病的位置。你可以感知到每種毒素、生物或疫病的類型。

該法術無法穿透1呎厚的石頭、泥土、木頭，1吋厚的金屬或薄薄一層鉛。

Detect Thoughts.name: 偵測思想
Detect Thoughts.description:
你啟動以下效果之一。直到法術結束前，你可以在後續回合以魔法行動啟動任一效果。

【感知思想】你感知自身周圍30呎內知曉一門語言或具有心靈感應能力生物的思想。你不能讀取這些思想，但你知道有一個有思想的生物存在。

該法術無法穿透1呎厚的石頭、泥土、木頭、1英寸厚的金屬或薄薄一層鉛。

【讀取思想】選擇30呎內一個你所能看見的生物，或者你通過感知思想選項探測到的生物。你瞭解此刻目標心中最大的想法。若目標不懂任何語言且不能進行心靈感應，則你一無所獲。

作為你下一回合的魔法動作，你可以嘗試深入目標的思維。若你深入思維，目標進行一次感知豁免。豁免失敗時，你將洞察到目標的理性、情緒，以及佔據其思維中重要位置的事情（比如擔憂、愛慕或憎恨）。豁免成功時，法術結束。無論結果如何，目標都知道你正在探測其思想，並且直到你將注意力從目標的思維上移開前，目標可以在其回合採取一個動作，進行一次[[/check ability=int skill=arc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]]檢定，對抗你的法術豁免DC，成功則法術結束。

Dimension Door.name: 次元門
Dimension Door.description:
你傳送至射程內一處地點，準確抵達想要到達的位置。該地點可以是你所能看見的、能在腦中想像的，或能用距離與方向描述的地點，例如「筆直向下200呎」或「朝西北上方45度角300呎」。

你也可以帶上一名自願生物一同傳送。當你傳送時，該生物必須位於你5呎內，並會傳送至你的目的地空間5呎內的一處空間。

若你、另一名生物或兩者都將抵達一處已被生物佔據，或被一個或多個物件完全填滿的空間，你和任何與你同行的生物各承受4d6力場傷害，且傳送失敗。

Disguise Self.name: 易容術
Disguise Self.description:
直到法術結束前，你使自己——包括你的衣物、護甲、武器以及你身上的其他物品——看起來不同。你可以讓自己顯得矮1呎或者高1呎，並且可以看起來更重或更輕。你偽裝成的的形態，必須與你四肢排列形式基本相同。除此之外，幻象的變化程度由你決定。

此法術產生的變化經不起物理檢驗，例如：若你使用此法術在你的裝扮上加一頂帽子，物體會穿過這頂帽子，且任何觸摸其人都會感覺不到任何東西。

要識破你的偽裝，一個生物必須採取研究動作以檢查你的外表，並且通過一次對抗你法術豁免DC的[[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spelldc]]檢定。

Disguised.name: 易容
Disguised.description: 要識破你的偽裝，一個生物必須採取研究動作以檢查你的外表，並且通過一次對抗你法術豁免DC的[[/check ability=int skill=inv]]檢定。

Study.condition: 其他生物採取研究動作
Study.name: 研究

Disintegrate.name: 解離術
Disintegrate.description:
You launch a green ray at a target you can see within range. The target can be a creature, a nonmagical object, or a creation of magical force, such as the wall created by @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWallofForc]{Wall of Force}.

A creature targeted by this spell makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 10d6 + 40 Force damage. If this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it and everything nonmagical it is wearing and carrying are disintegrated into gray dust. The target can be revived only by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplTrueResurr]{True Resurrection} or a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell.

This spell automatically disintegrates a Large or smaller nonmagical object or a creation of magical force. If such a target is Huge or larger, this spell disintegrates a 10-foot-Cube portion of it.

【升環法術效應】 The damage increases by 3d6 for each spell slot level above 6.

Dispel Evil and Good.name: 反制善惡
Dispel Evil and Good.description:
For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions.

Break Enchantment. As a Magic action, you touch a creature that is possessed by or has the &Reference[Charmed] or &Reference[Frightened] condition from one or more creatures of the types above. The target is no longer possessed, Charmed, or Frightened by such creatures.

Dismissal. As a Magic action, you target one creature you can see within 5 feet of you that has one of the creature types above. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be sent back to its home plane if it isn’t there already. If they aren’t on their home plane, Undead are sent to the Shadowfell, and Fey are sent to the Feywild.

Dispelling Evil and Good.description: For the duration, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. You can end the spell early by using either of the following special functions: Break Enchantment or Dismissal.
Dispelling Evil and Good.name: Dispelling Evil and Good

Dismissal.name: Dismissal
Dismissal.target: Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead

Break Enchantment.name: Break Enchantment
Break Enchantment.target: Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead

Dispel Magic.name: 解除魔法
Dispel Magic.description:
選擇射程內一個生物、物體或魔法效應。目標身上任何持續中的3環或更低環階法術都會結束。對於目標身上每一個持續中的4環或更高環階法術，以你的施法屬性進行一次屬性檢定（DC等於10加該法術的環階）。檢定成功時，該法術結束。

【升環法術效應】若目標身上法術的環階等於或低於你所使用法術位的環階，你會自動結束該法術。

Dissonant Whispers.name: 噪音暗語
Dissonant Whispers.description:
在法術範圍內選擇一個你所能看見的生物，在其腦中響起不和諧的旋律，目標進行一次感知豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，其承受3d6心靈傷害，且如果可能的話，必須立即使用其反應以最安全的路線盡可能遠離你。豁免成功時，目標只承受一半的傷害。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害將再增加1d6。

Divination.name: 預言術
Divination.description:
此法術使你與一名神祇或神祇的僕人取得聯繫。你可以就7日內將發生的一個特定目標、事件或活動提出一個問題。DM會給予真實的答覆，可能是一段短語或晦澀的韻文。該法術不會考量可能改變答案的情況，例如其他法術的施放。

若你在完成一次長休前施放此法術超過一次，則從第二次施放起，每次施放都有累積增加25%的機率得不到答覆。

Divine Favor.name: 神恩術
Divine Favor.description: 直到法術結束前，你的武器攻擊命中時造成額外1d4光耀傷害。

Divine Smite.name: 至聖斬
Divine Smite.description:
被攻擊的目標承受額外2d8光耀傷害，若目標為邪魔或不死生物，則傷害提升1d8。

【升環施法效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d8。

Divine Word.name: 聖言術
Divine Word.description:
You utter a word imbued with power from the Upper Planes. Each creature of your choice in range makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, a target that has 50 Hit Points or fewer suffers an effect based on its current Hit Points, as shown in the Divine Word Effects table. Regardless of its Hit Points, a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, or a Fiend target that fails its save is forced back to its plane of origin (if it isn’t there already) and can’t return to the current plane for 24 hours by any means short of a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplWish000000]{Wish} spell.

Hit PointsDivine Word Effect
0–20The target dies.
21–30The target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲}, &Reference[Deafened apply=false]{耳聾}, and &Reference[Stunned apply=false] conditions for 1 hour.
31–40The target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions for 10 minutes.
41–50The target has the Deafened condition for 1 minute.

Dominate Monster.name: 支配怪物
Dominate Monster.description:
One creature you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑} condition for the duration. The target has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

You have a telepathic link with the Charmed target while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as “Attack that creature,” “Move over there,” or “Fetch that object.” The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn’t receive further direction from you, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself.

You can command the target to take a Reaction but must take your own Reaction to do so.

【升環法術效應】 Your Concentration can last longer with a level 9 spell slot (up to 8 hours).

Dominated.name: Dominated
Dominated.description: Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the [[/save ability=wis]] save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

Dominate Person.name: 支配人類
Dominate Person.description:
One Humanoid you can see within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑} condition for the duration. The target has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the save, ending the spell on itself on a success.

You have a telepathic link with the Charmed target while the two of you are on the same plane of existence. On your turn, you can use this link to issue commands to the target (no action required), such as “Attack that creature,” “Move over there,” or “Fetch that object.” The target does its best to obey on its turn. If it completes an order and doesn’t receive further direction from you, it acts and moves as it likes, focusing on protecting itself.

You can command the target to take a Reaction but must take your own Reaction to do so.

【升環法術效應】 Your Concentration can last longer with a spell slot of level 6 (up to 10 minutes), 7 (up to 1 hour), or 8+ (up to 8 hours).

Dominated.name: Dominated
Dominated.description: 每當被&Reference[charmed apply=false]{魅惑}的目標承受傷害時，其重複進行[[/save ability=wis]]豁免，並在其成功時結束法術。

Dragon's Breath.name: 龍息術
Dragon's Breath.description:
你觸碰一個自願生物，並選擇強酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電或毒素。直到法術結束前，目標可以採取魔法動作來呼出一道15呎錐形區域的吐息。每個處於該區域內的生物進行一次敏捷豁免，失敗時承受3d6所選擇類型的傷害，成功時承受一半的傷害。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d6。

Drawmij's Instant Summons.name: 卓姆吉瞬間召喚
Drawmij's Instant Summons.description:
You touch the sapphire used in the casting and an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or less. The spell leaves an Invisible mark on that object and invisibly inscribes the object’s name on the sapphire. Each time you cast this spell, you must use a different sapphire.

Thereafter, you can take a Magic action to speak the object’s name and crush the sapphire. The object instantly appears in your hand regardless of physical or planar distances, and the spell ends.

If another creature is holding or carrying the object, crushing the sapphire doesn’t transport it, but instead you learn who that creature is and where that creature is currently located.

Foundry Note

This spell's Limited Uses are configured to track the number of inscribed objects, with the "Inscribe" and "Recall" activities restoring and consuming uses as appropriate.

Dream.name: 託夢術
Dream.description:
You target a creature you know on the same plane of existence. You or a willing creature you touch enters a trance state to act as a dream messenger. While in the trance, the messenger is &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] and has a Speed of 0.

If the target is asleep, the messenger appears in the target’s dreams and can converse with the target as long as it remains asleep, through the spell’s duration. The messenger can also shape the dream’s environment, creating landscapes, objects, and other images. The messenger can emerge from the trance at any time, ending the spell. The target recalls the dream perfectly upon waking.

If the target is awake when you cast the spell, the messenger knows it and can either end the trance (and the spell) or wait for the target to sleep, at which point the messenger enters its dreams.

You can make the messenger terrifying to the target. If you do so, the messenger can deliver a message of no more than ten words, and then the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains no benefit from its rest, and it takes 3d6 Psychic damage when it wakes up.

Trance State.description: While in the trance, the messenger is Incapacitated and has a Speed of 0.
Trance State.name: Trance State

Druidcraft.name: 德魯伊伎倆
Druidcraft.description:
向自然界的靈體低語，你在範圍內創造出以下效果之一。

【天氣預報】 你創造一個微小且無害的感覺效果，以預測你所在地點未來24小時的天氣狀況。這個效果可能會表現為金色光球以預示晴朗的天空、一朵雲彩以預示下雨、飄落的雪花以預示下雪等等。這個效果持續1輪。

【開花】 你立即使一朵花苞綻放、一個種子莢打開，或者一個嫩葉萌發。

【感官效果】你創造一個無害的感覺效果，例如落葉、飛舞的幻影仙靈、輕柔的微風、動物的聲音，或是淡淡的臭鼬氣味。這個效果必須在 5 呎的立方體空間內。

【玩火】 你點燃或熄滅一支蠟燭、一支火把或一個篝火。

Earthquake.name: 地震術
Earthquake.description:
Choose a point on the ground that you can see within range. For the duration, an intense tremor rips through the ground in a 100-foot-radius circle centered on that point. The ground there is Difficult Terrain.

When you cast this spell and at the end of each of your turns for the duration, each creature on the ground in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the &Reference[Prone] condition, and its Concentration is broken.

You can also cause the effects below.

Fissures. A total of [[/r 1d6]] fissures open in the spell’s area at the end of the turn you cast it. You choose the fissures’ locations, which can’t be under structures. Each fissure is [[/r 1d10 * 10]] feet deep and 10 feet wide, and it extends from one edge of the spell’s area to another edge. A creature in the same space as a fissure must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall in. A creature that successfully saves moves with the fissure’s edge as it opens.

Structures. The tremor deals [[/damage 50 type=bludgeoning]] damage to any structure in contact with the ground in the area when you cast the spell and at the end of each of your turns until the spell ends. If a structure drops to 0 Hit Points, it collapses.

A creature within a distance from a collapsing structure equal to half the structure’s height makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 12d6 Bludgeoning damage, has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition, and is buried in the rubble, requiring a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=20]] check as an action to escape. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only.

End of Turn Fissures.name: End of Turn Fissures
End of Turn Fissures.condition: end of turn of initial casting

Collapsing Structure Save.name: Collapsing Structure Save
Collapsing Structure Save.condition: when a structure drops to 0 Hit Points

Buried in Rubble.description: On a failed save, the creature takes 12d6 Bludgeoning damage, has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition, and is buried in the rubble, requiring a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=20]] check as an action to escape.
Buried in Rubble.name: Buried in Rubble

Eldritch Blast.name: 魔能爆
Eldritch Blast.description:
你投擲出一束劈啪作響的能量。對範圍內一個生物或物體進行遠程法術攻擊。命中時，目標承受1d10立場傷害。

【戲法升級】5級時，本法術會創造兩束能量，11級時創造三束能量，17級時創造四束能量。你可以將能量束指向同一個目標或者不同的目標。為每束能量單獨骰攻擊檢定。

[[(floor((@details.level+1)/6)+1)]]{總能量束}

Elemental Weapon.name: 元素武器
Elemental Weapon.description:
你觸碰的一把非魔法武器變成魔法武器。選擇下列其中一種傷害類型：強酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電、雷鳴。在持續期間內，該武器的攻擊檢定獲得+1加值，且命中時會額外造成1d4所選類型的傷害。

【升環法術效應】若你使用5至6環的法術位，攻擊檢定加值提升為+2，額外傷害提升為2d4。若你使用7環或更高的法術位，加值提升為+3，額外傷害提升為3d4。

Elementalism.name: 元素技倆
Elementalism.description:
你運用對元素的控制，在射程內創造下列效果中的一種。

【喚風】你創造出一股足夠強的微風，可以在一個5立方呎區域內掀動衣物、揚起灰塵、使樹葉沙沙作響，或者關閉敞開的門窗。如果門和百葉窗被某人或某物維持敞開，則其不受影響。

【喚土】你創造出一層薄薄的塵土或沙塵，覆蓋5平方呎的區域內的表面，或者讓一個單字以你的筆跡出現在一片泥土或沙地上。

【喚火】你在5立方呎區域內創造出一團無害的火星和彩色、有香味的煙霧。你選擇顏色和香味，且火星可以點燃該區域內的蠟燭、火把或燈具。煙霧的香味持續1分鐘。

【喚水】你在5立方呎區域內創造出一陣涼爽的霧氣，輕微地濕潤生物和物體。或者，你在開放的容器內或表面上創造出1杯清水，這些水會在1分鐘後蒸發。

【塑形元素】只要是能裝進1立方呎內的土、沙子、火、煙、霧或水，你就能使其呈現出一個粗糙的形狀（比如形如一個生物），持續 1 小時。

Beckon Element.name: 引導元素
Beckon Element.chatFlavor: 喚火與喚水持續 1 分鐘

Enhance Ability.name: 強化屬性
Enhance Ability.description:
你觸碰一個生物，並選擇力量、敏捷、智力、感知或魅力。法術持續時間內，目標在相應屬性檢定中具有優勢。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就可以額外選擇一個生物。你可以為每個目標選擇不同的屬性。

Enhanced Dexterity.name: 強化敏捷
Enhanced Dexterity.description: 目標在相應屬性檢定中具有優勢。

Enhanced Strength.description: 目標在相應屬性檢定中具有優勢。
Enhanced Strength.name: 強化力量

Enhanced Charisma.description: 目標在相應屬性檢定中具有優勢。
Enhanced Charisma.name: 強化魅力

Enhanced Wisdom.name: 強化感知
Enhanced Wisdom.description: 目標在相應屬性檢定中具有優勢。

Enhanced Intelligence.name: 強化智力
Enhanced Intelligence.description: 目標在相應屬性檢定中具有優勢。

Enlarge/Reduce.name: 變巨/縮小術
Enlarge/Reduce.description:
在持續期間內，法術會使你在射程內一個你所能看見的生物或物體的大小發生改變（見下方所選效果）。作為目標的物體不能被穿著或攜帶。若目標是非自願的生物，其可以進行一次體質豁免；豁免成功時，法術無效。

目標生物所穿著與攜帶的一切都會隨其改變大小。其掉落的任何物品會立即恢復為正常大小。投擲武器或彈藥在命中或未命中目標後，會立即恢復為正常大小。

【變巨】目標的體型增大一級，例如從中型變為大型。目標在力量檢定和力量豁免上具有優勢。目標以其變巨的武器或徒手打擊進行的攻擊，命中時額外造成1d4傷害。

【縮小】目標的體型縮小一級，例如從中型變為小型。目標在力量檢定和力量豁免上具有劣勢。目標以其縮小的武器或徒手打擊進行的攻擊，命中時少造成1d4傷害（此效果無法使傷害降至1以下）。

Reduced.name: 縮小
Reduced.description: 目標的體型縮小一級，例如從中型變為小型。目標在力量檢定和力量豁免上具有劣勢。目標以其縮小的武器或徒手打擊進行的攻擊，命中時少造成1d4傷害（此效果無法使傷害降至1以下）。

Enlarged.description: 目標的體型增大一級，例如從中型變為大型。目標在力量檢定和力量豁免上具有優勢。目標以其變巨的武器或徒手打擊進行的攻擊，命中時額外造成1d4傷害。
Enlarged.name: 變巨

Ensnaring Strike.name: 誘捕打擊
Ensnaring Strike.description:
當你命中目標時，纏繞的藤蔓會出現在其身上，其進行一次力量豁免。大型或更大的生物在此豁免上具有優勢。豁免失敗時，直到法術結束前目標陷入&Reference[restrained apply=false]{束縛}狀態。豁免成功時，藤蔓枯萎消失，且法術結束。

被束縛時，目標在其每回合開始時承受1d6穿刺傷害。目標或能夠觸及其的生物可以採取一個動作，[[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spelldc]]檢定，對抗你的法術豁免DC。成功時該法術結束。

【升環法術效應】 法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d6。

Ensnared.name: 誘捕
Ensnared.description:
直到法術結束前目標陷入&Reference[restrained apply=false]{束縛}狀態。

被束縛時，目標在其每回合開始時承受[[/damage 1d6 type=piercing]]（每個高於1環的法術位環階加上1d6）傷害。目標或能夠觸及其的生物可以採取一個動作，[[/check ability=str skill=ath]]檢定，對抗你的法術豁免DC。成功時該法術結束。

Entangle.name: 糾纏術
Entangle.description:
射程內一片20呎方形區域地面上生長出盤根錯節的植物。法術持續期間內，這些植物將該區域內的地面變為&Reference[difficultterrain]{困難地形}。當法術結束時植物消失。

當你施放法術時，區域內的每個生物（除你之外）必須成功通過一次力量豁免，否則直到法術結束前陷入&Reference[restrained apply=false]{束縛}狀態。一個處於束縛的生物可以採取一個動作，進行一次 [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spelldc]]檢定，對抗你的法術豁免DC。成功時，其能從攀緣植物中解脫出來，不再被植物束縛。

Restrained.description: 一個處於束縛的生物可以採取一個動作，進行一次[[/check ability=str skill=ath]]檢定，對抗你的法術豁免DC。成功時，其能從攀緣植物中解脫出來，不再被植物束縛。
Restrained.name: 束縛

Enthrall.name: 注目術
Enthrall.description: 你編織了一系列令人分心的言辭，選擇射程內你所能看見的任意數量的生物，迫使其進行一次感知豁免。任何生物，你或你的同伴正在戰鬥中的生物在此豁免上自動成功。豁免失敗時，直到法術結束前目標進行感知（察覺）檢定時會承受-10的罰值，並且被動察覺也會降低同樣數值。

Distracted.name: 分心
Distracted.description: 直到法術結束前目標進行[[/check ability=wis skill=prc]]檢定時會承受-10的罰值，並且被動察覺也會降低同樣數值。

Etherealness.name: 跨入乙太界
Etherealness.description:
You step into the border regions of the Ethereal Plane, where it overlaps with your current plane. You remain in the Border Ethereal for the duration. During this time, you can move in any direction. If you move up or down, every foot of movement costs an extra foot. You can perceive the plane you left, which looks gray, and you can’t see anything there more than 60 feet away.

While on the Ethereal Plane, you can affect and be affected only by creatures, objects, and effects on that plane. Creatures that aren’t on the Ethereal Plane can’t perceive or interact with you unless a feature gives them the ability to do so.

When the spell ends, you return to the plane you left in the spot that corresponds to your space in the Border Ethereal. If you appear in an occupied space, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take Force damage equal to twice the number of feet you are moved.

This spell ends instantly if you cast it while you are on the Ethereal Plane or a plane that doesn’t border it, such as one of the Outer Planes.

【升環法術效應】You can target up to three willing creatures (including yourself) for each spell slot level above 7. The creatures must be within 10 feet of you when you cast the spell.

Evard's Black Tentacles.name: 艾伐黑觸手
Evard's Black Tentacles.description:
蠕動的烏黑觸手填滿射程內一處你所能看見、邊長20呎的方形地面。在持續期間內，這些觸手使該區域的地面成為&Reference[DifficultTerrain]{困難地形}。

該區域內的每名生物進行一次力量豁免。豁免失敗時，其承受3d6鈍擊傷害，並且直到法術結束前陷入&Reference[Restrained apply=false]{束縛}狀態。生物進入該區域或在其中結束其回合時，也會進行該豁免。生物每回合只會進行一次此豁免。

陷入束縛狀態的生物可以採取動作，進行一次對抗你法術豁免DC的[[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spell.dc]]檢定，成功時結束其身上的狀態。

Restrained.name: 束縛
Restrained.description: 陷入&Reference[Restrained apply=false]{束縛}狀態的生物可以採取動作，進行一次對抗你法術豁免DC的[[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spell.dc]]檢定，成功時結束其身上的狀態。

Expeditious Retreat.name: 腳底抹油
Expeditious Retreat.description: 你採取疾走動作，且直到法術結束前，你都能以附贈動作再次採取該動作。

Eyebite.name: 攝心目光
Eyebite.description:
For the duration, your eyes become an inky void. One creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that you can see must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by one of the following effects of your choice for the duration.

On each of your turns until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to target another creature but can’t target a creature again if it has succeeded on a save against this casting of the spell.

Asleep. The target has the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition. It wakes up if it takes any damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

Panicked. The target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐懼} condition. On each of its turns, the Frightened target must take the &Reference[Dash] action and move away from you by the safest and shortest route available. If the target moves to a space at least 60 feet away from you where it can’t see you, this effect ends.

Sickened. The target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition.

Asleep.description: The target has the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition. It wakes up if it takes any damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.
Asleep.name: 睡眠

Panicked.description: The target has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐懼} condition. On each of its turns, the Frightened target must take the &Reference[Dash] action and move away from you by the safest and shortest route available. If the target moves to a space at least 60 feet away from you where it can’t see you, this effect ends.
Panicked.name: Panicked

Fabricate.name: 鬼斧神工
Fabricate.description:
你將原材料轉化為同種材料製成的成品。例如，你可以將一叢樹木製成木橋、一片麻草製成繩索，或將亞麻或羊毛製成衣物。

選擇射程內你所能看見的原材料。只要材料數量足夠，你就可以製造一件大型或更小的物件（容納於10呎立方體，或八個相連的5呎立方體內）。然而，若你使用金屬、石料或其他礦物材料，製造的物件就不能大於中型（容納於5呎立方體內）。任何製成物件的品質都取決於原材料的品質。

此法術無法創造生物或魔法物品。你也無法用此法術創造需要高度技藝的物品，例如武器或護甲，除非你具有製作該物件所需類型工匠工具的熟練。

Faerie Fire.name: 妖火術
Faerie Fire.description:
射程內20立方呎區域內的物體將被藍色、綠色或堇紫色的光勾勒出輪廓（由你選擇）。每個在立方體範圍內敏捷豁免失敗的生物，也會被勾勒出輪廓。在法術持續時間內，物體和受影響的生物會發出10呎&Reference[dimlight]{微光光照}，並且不能受惠於隱形狀態。

若攻擊者可以看到受影響的生物或物體，則對其的攻擊檢定就具有優勢。

Outlined.name: 勾勒輪廓
Outlined.description:
在法術持續時間內，物體和受影響的生物會在散發出10呎&Reference[dimlight]{微光}，並且無法受惠於隱形狀態。

若攻擊者可以看到受影響的生物或物體，則對其的攻擊檢定就具有優勢。

False Life.name: 摹造生命
False Life.description:
你獲得2d4 + 4的臨時生命值。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，你就可以獲得額外5點臨時生命值。

Fear.name: 恐懼術
Fear.description:
30呎錐形區域內的每個生物都必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則會丟下手中所持之物，並在持續期間內陷入&Reference[frightened apply=false]{恐慌}狀態。

陷入恐慌的生物在其每個回合都會採取&Reference[dash]{疾走}動作，並沿著最安全的路線遠離你，除非無處可去。若該生物在無法看見你的空間結束其回合，則進行一次感知豁免；成功時，法術對該生物結束。

Fear.name: 恐懼
Fear.description: 陷入&Reference[frightened apply=false]{恐慌}的生物在其每個回合都會採取&Reference[dash]{疾走}動作，並沿著最安全的路線遠離你，除非無處可去。若該生物在無法看見你的空間結束其回合，則進行一次[[/save ability=wis]]豁免；成功時，法術對該生物結束。

Feather Fall.name: 羽落術
Feather Fall.description: 選擇射程內至多五個正在墜落的生物。直到法術結束前，一個生物正在下落時的下降速度減慢至每輪60呎。若一個生物在法術結束前著陸，該生物不會因墜落而承受任何傷害，且該生物上的法術結束。

Feign Death.name: 假死術
Feign Death.description:
你觸碰一個自願的生物，使其進入與死亡無異的僵直狀態。

在持續期間內，無論是外觀檢查，還是用來判定目標狀態的法術，目標看起來都像已死亡。目標陷入&Reference[blinded apply=false]{目盲}與&Reference[incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態，且其速度為0。

目標對除心靈傷害以外的所有傷害具有抗力，並對中毒狀態免疫。

Find Familiar.name: 尋獲魔寵
Find Familiar.description:
一隻魔寵前來服務你。這個靈體有著你所選擇的動物形態：蝙蝠、貓、青蛙、獵鷹、蜥蜴、章魚、貓頭鷹、老鼠、渡鴉、蜘蛛、鼬，或其他挑戰等級為0的野獸。魔寵在射程內未佔據的空間出現，魔寵具有所選形態的資料（見附錄B），不過其是天界、妖精或邪魔生物（由你選擇）而非野獸。你的魔寵將獨立行動， 但其會服從你的命令。

【心靈感應連接】當魔寵在你100呎內時，你可以與其通過心靈感應交流。此外，作為附贈動作，直到你下回合開始前，你可以通過魔寵的眼睛看東西，聽到其聽到的聲音，並獲得其所擁有的任何特殊感官的好處。

最後，當你施放一個射程為觸碰的法術時，你的魔寵可以傳遞該觸碰。你的魔寵必須在你100呎內，並且當你施放法術時，其必須採取反應來傳遞該觸碰。

【戰鬥】魔寵是你的同伴以及你同伴的同伴。其擲自己的先攻並在自己的回合行動。魔寵不能攻擊，但可以正常採取其他動作。

【魔寵消失】當魔寵的生命值減少至0點時，其將消失。在你再次施放此法術後重新出現。作為魔法動作，你可以暫時將魔寵解散至一個口袋維度。或者，你可以永久性地解散。當魔寵暫解散時作為一個魔法動作，你可以使其在你30呎內一個未佔據的空間重新出現。每當魔寵的生命值降至0點或消失進入口袋維度時，其將所穿著或攜帶的所有物品留在其原本的空間。

【只有一個魔寵】 你不能同時擁有多個的魔寵。若你在已有魔寵時施放此法術，你轉而將原有魔寵轉變成一個新的符合條件的形態。

Find Steed.name: 尋獲坐騎
Find Steed.description:
你召喚一個異界存在，其以忠誠坐騎的樣貌出現在射程內你所選的未佔據的空間中。此生物使用@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobOtherworld]{異界坐騎}的數值面板。若你已經擁有以此法術獲得的坐騎，該坐騎會被新的坐騎取代。
