If another creature that can see the wall moves within 20 feet of it or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the &Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲} condition for 1 minute.

The wall consists of seven layers, each with a different color. When a creature reaches into or passes through the wall, it does so one layer at a time through all the layers. Each layer forces the creature to make a Dexterity saving throw or be affected by that layer’s properties as described in the Prismatic Layers table.

The wall, which has AC 10, can be destroyed one layer at a time, in order from red to violet, by means specific to each layer. If a layer is destroyed, it is gone for the duration. @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplAntimagicF]{Antimagic Field} has no effect on the wall, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{Dispel Magic} can affect only the violet layer.

Prismatic Layers
OrderEffects
1Red. Failed Save: 12d6 Fire damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: Nonmagical ranged attacks can’t pass through this layer, which is destroyed if it takes at least 25 Cold damage.
2Orange. Failed Save: 12d6 Acid damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: Magical ranged attacks can’t pass through this layer, which is destroyed by a strong wind (such as the one created by @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGustofWind]{Gust of Wind}).
3Yellow. Failed Save: 12d6 Lightning damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 60 Force damage.
4Green. Failed Save: 12d6 Poison damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: A @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplPasswall00]{Passwall} spell, or another spell of equal or greater level that can open a portal on a solid surface, destroys this layer.
5Blue. Failed Save: 12d6 Cold damage. Successful Save: Half as much damage. Additional Effects: The layer is destroyed if it takes at least 25 Fire damage.
6Indigo. Failed Save: The target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition and makes a [[/save ability=con dc=@attributes.spelldc format=long]] at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the condition ends. If it fails three times, it has the &Reference[Petrified] condition until it is freed by an effect like the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Greater Restoration} spell. The successes and failures needn’t be consecutive; keep track of both until the target collects three of a kind. Additional Effects: Spells can’t be cast through this layer, which is destroyed by Bright Light shed by the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDaylight00]{Daylight} spell.
7Violet. Failed Save: The target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲} condition and makes a [[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spelldc format=long]] at the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the condition ends. On a failed save, the condition ends, and the creature teleports to another plane of existence (DM’s choice). Additional Effects: This layer is destroyed by @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{Dispel Magic}.

Blinding Save.range: measured from nearest point on wall or globe

Restrained (Indigo).description: The target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition and makes a [[/save ability=con dc=@attributes.spell.dc]] format=long]] at the end of each of its turns. If it successfully saves three times, the condition ends. If it fails three times, it has the &Reference[Petrified] condition until it is freed by an effect like the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Greater Restoration} spell.

On a successful save, the condition ends. On a failed save, the condition ends, and the creature teleports to another plane of existence (DM’s choice).

Prismatic Blinding.name: Prismatic Blinding
Prismatic Blinding.description: The target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲} condition for 1 minute.

Produce Flame.name: 燃火術
Produce Flame.description:
一團閃爍的火焰出現在你的手中，並在持續時間內留在手中。當火焰仍在，則火焰不會散發熱量，也不會點燃任何東西，但會散發20呎明亮光照，再延伸出20呎微光光照區域。若你再次施法則法術終止。

直到法術結束前，你可以採取魔法動作對60呎內一個生物或物體投擲火焰。發動一次遠程法術攻擊。命中時，目標承受1d8火焰傷害。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d8、11級3d8、17級4d8。

Programmed Illusion.name: 預置幻象
Programmed Illusion.description:
You create an illusion of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon within range that activates when a specific trigger occurs. The illusion is imperceptible until then. It must be no larger than a 30-foot Cube, and you decide when you cast the spell how the illusion behaves and what sounds it makes. This scripted performance can last up to 5 minutes.

When the trigger you specify occurs, the illusion springs into existence and performs in the manner you described. Once the illusion finishes performing, it disappears and remains dormant for 10 minutes, after which the illusion can be activated again.

The trigger can be as general or as detailed as you like, though it must be based on visual or audible phenomena that occur within 30 feet of the area. For example, you could create an illusion of yourself to appear and warn off others who attempt to open a trapped door.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be illusory, since things can pass through it. A creature that takes the Study action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful [[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spelldc]] check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and any noise it makes sounds hollow to the creature.

Study.name: Study
Study.condition: Study Action taken by other creature

Project Image.name: 投射幻影
Project Image.description:
You create an illusory copy of yourself that lasts for the duration. The copy can appear at any location within range that you have seen before, regardless of intervening obstacles. The illusion looks and sounds like you, but it is intangible. If the illusion takes any damage, it disappears, and the spell ends.

You can see through the illusion’s eyes and hear through its ears as if you were in its space. As a Magic action, you can move it up to 60 feet and make it gesture, speak, and behave in whatever way you choose. It mimics your mannerisms perfectly.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be illusory, since things can pass through it. A creature that takes the Study action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful [[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spelldc]] check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and any noise it makes sounds hollow to the creature.

Study.condition: Study Action taken by other creature
Study.name: Study

Protection from Energy.name: 防護能量
Protection from Energy.description: 在法術持續期間，你所觸碰的自願生物對一個你所選擇的傷害類型擁有抗力：強酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電、雷鳴。

Protection from Evil and Good.name: 防護善惡
Protection from Evil and Good.description: 你觸碰一個自願生物，直到法術結束前為其提供對異怪、天界、元素、精類、邪魔或不死生物的防護。該防護給予數個好處。這些類型的生物在對目標的攻擊檢定中具有劣勢。目標也不能被這類生物附身，或陷入對這類生物的&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}或&Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐懼}狀態。若目標已經被這類生物附身、或陷入對這類生物的魅惑或恐懼狀態，則目標對相關效果的任何新豁免檢定都具有優勢。

Protected.name: 受防護
Protected.description: 這些類型的生物在對目標的攻擊檢定中有劣勢。目標也不能被此類生物附身，或陷入對此類生物的&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}或&Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐懼}狀態。

Protection from Poison.name: 防護毒素
Protection from Poison.description: 你觸碰一個生物並結束其&Reference[poisoned]{中毒}狀態。在法術持續期間，目標在迴避或結束中毒狀態的豁免檢定中具有優勢，且其獲得毒素傷害的抗力。

Poison Protection.name: 毒素防護
Poison Protection.description: 在持續期間內，目標在迴避或結束中毒狀態的豁免檢定中具有優勢，且其獲得毒素傷害的抗性。

Purify Food and Drink.name: 淨化飲食
Purify Food and Drink.description: 你清除以射程內一點為中心，半徑5呎球形區域內非魔法食物及飲品中的毒素和腐敗。

Raise Dead.name: 喚醒死者
Raise Dead.description:
With a touch, you revive a dead creature if it has been dead no longer than 10 days and it wasn’t Undead when it died.

The creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point. This spell also neutralizes any poisons that affected the creature at the time of death.

This spell closes all mortal wounds, but it doesn’t restore missing body parts. If the creature is lacking body parts or organs integral for its survival—its head, for instance—the spell automatically fails.

Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Resurrection Sickness (Day 1).name: Resurrection Sickness (Day 1)
Resurrection Sickness (Day 1).description: Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Resurrection Sickness (Day 4).name: Resurrection Sickness (Day 4)
Resurrection Sickness (Day 4).description: Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Resurrection Sickness (Day 2).description: Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.
Resurrection Sickness (Day 2).name: Resurrection Sickness (Day 2)

Resurrection Sickness (Day 3).name: Resurrection Sickness (Day 3)
Resurrection Sickness (Day 3).description: Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Rary's Telepathic Bond.name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
Rary's Telepathic Bond.description:
You forge a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures of your choice within range, psychically linking each creature to all the others for the duration. Creatures that can’t communicate in any languages aren’t affected by this spell.

Until the spell ends, the targets can communicate telepathically through the bond whether or not they share a language. The communication is possible over any distance, though it can’t extend to other planes of existence.

Ray of Enfeeblement.name: 衰弱射線
Ray of Enfeeblement.description:
一束衰敗的能量從你身上射向射程內一個生物。目標必須進行一次體質豁免。豁免成功時，直到你下回合開始前，目標在下一次攻擊檢定時具有劣勢。

豁免失敗時，在法術持續時間內，目標基於力量的D20檢定上具有劣勢。在此期間，其所有傷害骰也會減少1d8。目在每回合結束時重複該豁免，成功時法術結束。

Enervated.name: 衰弱
Enervated.description: 目標基於力量的D20檢定上具有劣勢。在此期間，其所有傷害骰也會減少1d8。目標在每回合結束時重複[[/save ability=con]]豁免，成功時法術結束。

Brief Enfeeblement.description: 直到你下回合開始前，目標在下一次攻擊檢定時具有劣勢。
Brief Enfeeblement.name: 短暫衰弱

Ray of Frost.name: 冷凍射線
Ray of Frost.description:
一束寒冷的藍白色光束射向射程內的一個生物。對目標發動一次遠程法術攻擊。命中時，其承受1d8冷凍傷害，且直到你下回合開始前，其速度降低10呎。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d8、11級3d8、17級4d8。

Reduced Movement.name: 減少移動力
Reduced Movement.description: 直到你下回合開始前，目標速度降低10呎。

Ray of Sickness.name: 致病射線
Ray of Sickness.description:
你向射程內的一個生物射出一道微綠色射線。對目標進行一次遠程法術攻擊。命中時，目標會承受2d8毒素傷害，且直到你下回合結束前陷入&Reference[poisoned]{中毒}狀態。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d8。

Regenerate.name: 再生術
Regenerate.description: A creature you touch regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points. For the duration, the target regains [[/healing 1 type=healing]]{1 Hit Point} at the start of each of its turns, and any severed body parts regrow after 2 minutes.

Regenerating.description: For the duration, the target regains [[/healing 1 type=healing]]{1 Hit Point} at the start of each of its turns, and any severed body parts regrow after 2 minutes.
Regenerating.name: Regenerating

Reincarnate.name: 轉生術
Reincarnate.description:
You touch a dead Humanoid or a piece of one. If the creature has been dead no longer than 10 days, the spell forms a new body for it and calls the soul to enter that body. @Embed[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.tables.RollTable.phbsplReincarnat rollable classes="caption-top"]

The reincarnated creature makes any choices that a species’ description offers, and the creature recalls its former life. It retains the capabilities it had in its original form, except it loses the traits of its previous species and gains the traits of its new one.

Remove Curse.name: 移除詛咒
Remove Curse.description: 隨著你的觸碰，所有影響一個生物或物體的詛咒都會結束。若該物體是被詛咒的魔法物品，其詛咒仍會存在，但此法術會破壞其擁有者與該物體的同調，使其得以被卸下或丟棄。

Resistance.name: 提升抗力
Resistance.description: 你觸碰一個自願生物，並選擇一項傷害類型：強酸、鈍擊、寒冷、火焰、閃電、黯蝕、穿刺、毒素、光耀、揮砍或雷鳴。在法術結束前，當該生物承受所選類型的傷害，則其可以擲一顆d4，並使傷害總值減少擲骰的結果。一個生物每回合只能從此法術受益一次。

Fire Protection.name: Fire Protection
Fire Protection.description: When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by [[/r 1d4]]. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.

Lightning Protection.description: When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by [[/r 1d4]]. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.

Cold Protection.description: When the creature takes damage of the chosen type before the spell ends, the creature reduces the total damage taken by [[/r 1d4]]. A creature can benefit from this spell only once per turn.

Resurrection.name: 復活術
Resurrection.description:
With a touch, you revive a dead creature that has been dead for no more than a century, didn’t die of old age, and wasn’t Undead when it died.

The creature returns to life with all its Hit Points. This spell also neutralizes any poisons that affected the creature at the time of death. This spell closes all mortal wounds and restores any missing body parts.

Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Casting this spell to revive a creature that has been dead for 365 days or longer taxes you. Until you finish a Long Rest, you can’t cast spells again, and you have Disadvantage on D20 Tests.

Resurrection Sickness (Day 3).name: Resurrection Sickness (Day 3)
Resurrection Sickness (Day 3).description: Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.

Resurrection Sickness (Day 4).name: Resurrection Sickness (Day 4)
Resurrection Sickness (Day 4).description: Coming back from the dead is an ordeal. The target takes a −4 penalty to D20 Tests. Every time the target finishes a Long Rest, the penalty is reduced by 1 until it becomes 0.
