Reverse Gravity.name: 重力反轉
Reverse Gravity.description:
This spell reverses gravity in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot high Cylinder centered on a point within range. All creatures and objects in that area that aren’t anchored to the ground fall upward and reach the top of the Cylinder. A creature can make a Dexterity saving throw to grab a fixed object it can reach, thus avoiding the fall upward.

If a ceiling or an anchored object is encountered in this upward fall, creatures and objects strike it just as they would during a downward fall. If an affected creature or object reaches the Cylinder’s top without striking anything, it hovers there for the duration. When the spell ends, affected objects and creatures fall downward.

Revivify.name: 回生術
Revivify.description: 你觸碰一個在過去1分鐘內死亡的生物。該生物以1點生命值復活。此法術無法復活因年老而死的生物，也無法恢復任何缺失的身體部位。

Rope Trick.name: 通天繩
Rope Trick.description:
你觸碰一條繩索。其一端會向上浮起，直到繩索與地面垂直懸掛，或繩索觸及天花板。在繩索上端會開啟一道隱形的3呎乘5呎傳送門，通往一個持續至法術結束的異次元空間。可以沿著繩索攀爬進入該空間，繩索也可以被拉入該空間或從中丟出。

該空間可容納至多八個中型或更小的生物。攻擊、法術和其他效果無法穿入或穿出該空間，但空間內的生物可以透過傳送門向外看。法術結束時，空間內的一切東西都會掉出來。

Sacred Flame.name: 聖焰
Sacred Flame.description:
你對射程內你所能看見的一個生物降下火焰般的光輝。目標必須成功通過一次敏捷豁免，否則將承受1d8光耀傷害。目標在此豁免中不會獲得來自半身掩護或四分之三掩護的好處。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d8、11級3d8、17級4d8。

Sanctuary.name: 聖所
Sanctuary.description: 你為施法距離內的一名生物施加防護。在法術終止前，任何以攻擊檢定或傷害性法術將受防護的生物指定為目標的生物，都必須成功通過一次[[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spell.dc format=long]]，否則必須重新選擇一個新目標，或者失去該次攻擊或法術。此法術無法保護受防護的生物免受區域效應的影響。若受防護的生物進行了攻擊檢定、施放了法術或造成了傷害，則該法術提前終止。

Warded.description:
在法術終止前，任何以攻擊檢定或傷害性法術將受防護的生物指定為目標的生物，都必須成功通過一次[[/save ability=wis format=long]]，否則必須重新選擇一個新目標，或者失去該次攻擊或法術。

若受防護的生物進行了攻擊檢定、施放了法術或造成了傷害，則此法術提前終止。
Warded.name: 受防護

Scorching Ray.name: 灼熱射線
Scorching Ray.description:
你投擲三道灼熱的射線。你可以將射線擲向射程內的一個或多個目標。為每道射線進行遠程法術攻擊檢定。命中時，目標承受2d6火焰傷害。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就額外創造一道射線。

[[@item.level + 1]]{射線總數}

Scrying.name: 探知
Scrying.description:
You can see and hear a creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified (see the tables below) by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. The target doesn’t know what it is making the save against, only that it feels uneasy.

Your Knowledge of the Target Is …Save Modifier
Secondhand (heard of the target)+5
Firsthand (met the target)+0
Extensive (know the target well)−5
You Have the Target’s …Save Modifier
Picture or other likeness−2
Garment or other possession−4
Body part, lock of hair, or bit of nail−10

On a successful save, the target isn’t affected, and you can’t use this spell on it again for 24 hours.

On a failed save, the spell creates an Invisible, intangible sensor within 10 feet of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration. If something can see the sensor, it appears as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.

Instead of targeting a creature, you can target a location you have seen. When you do so, the sensor appears at that location and doesn’t move.

Create Sensor.name: Create Sensor
Create Sensor.target: at target location or within 10 feet of target creature

Searing Smite.name: 熾焰斬
Searing Smite.description:
當你命中目標時，其在該攻擊中額外承受1d6火焰傷害。直到法術結束前，目標每個回合開始時，承受1d6火焰傷害，然後進行一次體質豁免。豁免失敗時，法術繼續生效。豁免成功時，法術終止。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，所有的傷害都增加1d6。

Seared.name: 灼燒
Seared.description: 直到法術結束前，目標每個回合開始時，承受[[/damage 1d6 type=fire]]傷害，然後進行一次[[/save ability=con]]豁免。豁免失敗時，法術繼續生效。豁免成功時，法術終止。

See Invisibility.name: 識破隱形
See Invisibility.description: 在法術持續時間內，你可以看見處於&Reference[invisible apply=false]{隱形}狀態的生物和物體，就像其為可見一般，而且你還可以看到乙太位面。那裡的生物和物體看起來像幽靈一樣。

Seeming.name: 偽裝術
Seeming.description:
You give an illusory appearance to each creature of your choice that you can see within range. An unwilling target can make a Charisma saving throw, and if it succeeds, it is unaffected by this spell.

You can give the same appearance or different ones to the targets. The spell can change the appearance of the targets’ bodies and equipment. You can make each creature seem 1 foot shorter or taller and appear heavier or lighter. A target’s new appearance must have the same basic arrangement of limbs as the target, but the extent of the illusion is otherwise up to you. The spell lasts for the duration.

The changes wrought by this spell fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, if you use this spell to add a hat to a creature’s outfit, objects pass through the hat.

A creature that takes the Study action to examine a target can make an [[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spelldc]] check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it becomes aware that the target is disguised.

Changed Appearance.description: A creature that takes the Study action to examine a target can make an [[/check ability=int skill=inv]] check against your spell save DC. If it succeeds, it becomes aware that the target is disguised.
Changed Appearance.name: Changed Appearance

Study.condition: Study Action taken by other creature
Study.name: Study

Sending.name: 短訊術
Sending.description:
你向一個你曾見過的生物，或一個由曾見過該生物之人向你描述過的生物，傳送一則25字以內的短訊。目標會在腦海中聽見該訊息，若認識你則會認出你是發訊者，並能立即以同樣方式回覆。法術使目標能夠理解你訊息的含義。

你可以將訊息傳送至任何距離，甚至傳到其他存在位面，但若目標與你不在同一位面，訊息有5%的機率無法送達。你會得知傳送是否失敗。

收到你的訊息後，生物可以阻擋你以此法術再次聯繫該生物的能力，持續8小時。若你在這段時間內試圖傳送另一則訊息，你會得知自己被阻擋，且法術失敗。

Sequester.name: 隔離術
Sequester.description:
With a touch, you magically sequester an object or a willing creature. For the duration, the target has the Invisible condition and can’t be targeted by Divination spells, detected by magic, or viewed remotely with magic.

If the target is a creature, it enters a state of suspended animation; it has the Unconscious condition, doesn’t age, and doesn’t need food, water, or air.

You can set a condition for the spell to end early. The condition can be anything you choose, but it must occur or be visible within 1 mile of the target. Examples include “after 1,000 years” or “when the tarrasque awakens.” This spell also ends if the target takes any damage.

Sequestered.name: Sequestered
Sequestered.description: If the target is a creature, it enters a state of suspended animation; it has the &Reference[Unconscious apply=false] condition, doesn’t age, and doesn’t need food, water, or air. This spell also ends if the target takes any damage.

Shapechange.name: 形體變化
Shapechange.description:
You shape-shift into another creature for the duration or until you take a Magic action to shape-shift into a different eligible form. The new form must be of a creature that has a Challenge Rating no higher than your level or Challenge Rating. You must have seen the sort of creature before, and it can’t be a Construct or an Undead.

When you shape-shift, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the form. The spell ends early if you have no Temporary Hit Points left.

Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; Hit Points; Hit Point Dice; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting feature, you retain it too.

Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you’re in it.

Shatter.name: 粉碎音波
Shatter.description:
一陣巨大的噪音從你在射程內選擇的一點爆發。以該點為中心、半徑10呎的球形區域內的每個生物都必須進行一次體質豁免，豁免失敗時受到3d8點雷鳴傷害，成功時則傷害減半。構裝生物在此豁免上具有劣勢。

若有未被穿著或攜帶的非魔法物件位於法術區域內，也會受到該傷害。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d8。

Shield.name: 護盾術
Shield.description: 一道難以察覺的魔法力場護盾保護著你。直到你的下一回合開始前，你獲得AC +5加值（包含對觸發此法術的攻擊生效），且你不會承受來自@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{魔法飛彈}的傷害。

Imperceptible Barrier.description: 直到你的下一回合開始前，你獲得AC +5加值（包含對觸發此法術的攻擊生效），且你不會承受來自魔法飛彈的傷害。
Imperceptible Barrier.name: 難以察覺的護盾

Shield of Faith.name: 虔誠護盾
Shield of Faith.description: 一片閃著微光的力場圍繞射程內一名你所選擇的生物，在法術持續期間內使其獲得AC +2的加值。

Shimmering Field.description: 目標在法術持續時間內獲得AC +2的加值
Shimmering Field.name: 微光力場

Shillelagh.name: 橡棍術
Shillelagh.description:
你手持的棍棒或長棍滿溢著自然之力。在法術持續時間內，你可以使用你的施法屬性而非力量，計算該武器的近戰攻擊檢定與傷害骰，並且武器的傷害骰變成d8。若攻擊造成傷害，則其可以是力場傷害或該武器的普通傷害類型（由你選擇）。

若你再次施放，或你放開該武器，則法術將提前結束。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級d10、11級d12、17級2d6。

Shining Smite.name: 閃耀斬
Shining Smite.description:
被該打擊命中的目標會因該次攻擊額外承受2d6點光耀傷害。直到法術結束前，目標會發出半徑5呎的&Reference[BrightLight]{明亮光照}，對其進行的攻擊檢定具有優勢，且其無法受益於&Reference[Invisible]{隱形}狀態。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d6。

Shining.name: 閃耀
Shining.description: 直到法術結束前，目標會發出半徑5呎的&Reference[BrightLight]{明亮光照}，對其進行的攻擊檢定具有優勢，且其無法受益於&Reference[Invisible]{隱形}狀態。

Silence.name: 沉默術
Silence.description: 在法術持續時間內，以射程內你所選擇的點為中心，半徑20呎的球形區域內不能產生任何聲音，也沒有聲音可以通過該區域。任何完全在球形區域內的生物或物體都免疫雷鳴傷害，並且生物完全在球體內時陷入&Reference[deafened apply=false]{耳聾}狀態。在該區域內，不能施放包含聲音構材的法術。

Silenced.description: 任何完全在球形區域內的生物或物體都免疫雷鳴傷害，並且生物完全在球體內時陷入&Reference[deafened apply=false]{耳聾}狀態。在該區域內，不能施放包含聲音構材的法術。
Silenced.name: 沉默

Silent Image.name: 無聲幻影
Silent Image.description:
你創建一個物體、生物或其他可見現象的圖像，其大小不超過15立方呎。圖像會出現在射程內的一點，並持續到法術結束。圖像是純視覺的，不伴有聲音、氣味或其他感官效果。

作為一個魔法動作，你可以讓圖像移動到範圍內的任何位置。隨著圖像位置的變化，你可以調整圖像的外觀，使其移動顯得自然。例如，若你創建一個生物的圖像並移動之，則你可以改變圖像，使其看起來像在行走。

與圖像的物理互動將揭示其為幻象，因其可被事物穿過。一個採取研究動作以檢查圖像的生物，可以通過對抗你的法術豁免DC的[[/check ability=int skill=inv dc=@attributes.spelldc]]檢定，以確定其為幻象。若一個生物識破幻象，其視覺就能穿透幻象。

Study.name: 研究
Study.condition: 其他生物採取研究動作

Simulacrum.name: 擬像術
Simulacrum.description:
You create a simulacrum of one Beast or Humanoid that is within 10 feet of you for the entire casting of the spell. You finish the casting by touching both the creature and a pile of ice or snow that is the same size as that creature, and the pile turns into the simulacrum, which is a creature. It uses the game statistics of the original creature at the time of casting, except it is a Construct, its Hit Point maximum is half as much, and it can’t cast this spell.

The simulacrum is Friendly to you and creatures you designate. It obeys your commands and acts on your turn in combat. The simulacrum can’t gain levels, and it can’t take Short or Long Rests.

If the simulacrum takes damage, the only way to restore its Hit Points is to repair it as you take a Long Rest, during which you expend components worth 100 GP per Hit Point restored. The simulacrum must stay within 5 feet of you for the repair.

The simulacrum lasts until it drops to 0 Hit Points, at which point it reverts to snow and melts away. If you cast this spell again, any simulacrum you created with this spell is instantly destroyed.

Sleet Storm.name: 雪雨暴
Sleet Storm.description:
直到法術結束前，凍雨會落在以射程內你所選的一點為中心、高40呎、半徑20呎的圓柱體區域。該區域為&Reference[heavilyobscured]{重度遮蔽}，且區域內外露的火焰會被澆熄。

圓柱體內的地面為&Reference[difficultterrain]{困難地形}。當生物在一個回合內首次進入圓柱體，或在其中開始其回合時，必須成功通過一次敏捷豁免，否則陷入&Reference[prone]{伏地}狀態，並失去&Reference[concentration]{專注}。

Slow.name: 緩速術
Slow.description:
你扭曲射程內40呎立方體區域中至多六個你所選擇生物周圍的時間。每個目標都必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則在持續期間內受到此法術影響。

受影響的目標速度減半，AC與敏捷豁免承受−2懲罰，且無法採取反應。在其回合中，其只能採取一個動作或一個附贈動作，不能兩者皆有，且若採取攻擊動作，只能進行一次攻擊。若其施放具有姿勢構材的法術，會有[[/r 1d100cs>25#Spell cast successfully on 1]]{25%}的機率，因目標做出法術手勢太慢而使法術失敗。

受影響的目標在其每個回合結束時重複該豁免，成功時結束其身上的法術。

Foundry 註記

上方的行內擲骰成功時會回傳1，失敗時回傳0。

Slowed.name: 緩速
Slowed.description:
受影響的目標速度減半，AC與敏捷豁免承受−2懲罰，且無法採取反應。在其回合中，其只能採取一個動作或一個附贈動作，不能兩者皆有，且若採取攻擊動作，只能進行一次攻擊。若其施放具有姿勢構材的法術，會有[[/r 1d100cs>25#Spell cast successfully on 1]]{25%}的機率，因目標做出法術手勢太慢而使法術失敗。

受影響的目標在其每個回合結束時重複進行[[/save ability=wis]]豁免，成功時結束其身上的法術。

Sorcerous Burst.name: 術法爆發
Sorcerous Burst.description:
你向射程內一個生物或物體施放術法能量。對目標發動遠程攻擊檢定。命中時，該生物將承受1d8你所選擇的傷害類型，從以下類型中選擇：強酸、寒冷、火焰、閃電、毒素、心靈、或雷鳴。

若你在d8上擲出了8，則你可以再擲一次d8，並將其計入傷害值。當你施放此法術時，你可以為法術傷害增加的最大d8數量等同於你的施法屬性調整值。

【戲法升級】 當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d8、11級3d8、17級4d8。

Spare the Dying.name: 拯救瀕死
Spare the Dying.description:
選擇射程內一個生命值為0但尚未死亡的生物。該生物變得傷勢穩定。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時射程翻倍：5 級 30呎、11 級 60呎、17 級 120呎。

Speak with Animals.name: 動物交談術
Speak with Animals.description:
在法術持續時間內，你能理解野獸並與其進行口語溝通，且你可以對其使用任何影響動作的技能選項。

對於與生存或陪伴無關的話題，大多數野獸能說的很少，但至少一隻野獸能夠為你提供關於附近地點及怪物的心得，包括其在過去一天內所察覺到的任何事物。

Speak with Dead.name: 死者交談術
Speak with Dead.description:
你賦予射程內一具你所選屍體生者的假象，使其能回答你提出的問題。該屍體必須有嘴，且若該生物死亡時是不死生物，則此法術宣告失敗。若該屍體在過去10天內曾是此法術的目標，法術同樣失敗。

直到法術結束前，你可以向屍體提出至多五個問題。屍體只知道其生前所知的事物，包括其生前所通曉的語言。回答通常簡短、晦澀或重複，且若你對屍體懷有敵意，或屍體認出你是敵人，屍體並無義務給出真實的回答。此法術不會讓該生物的靈魂回到其身體，只會喚回賦予其生機的靈。因此，屍體無法得知新的資訊、無法理解其死後發生的任何事，也無法推測未來的事件。

Speak with Plants.name: 植物交談術
Speak with Plants.description:
你賦予固定的30呎發散區域內的植物有限的知覺與生機，使其能與你溝通並遵從你簡單的命令。你可以向植物詢問法術區域內過去一天發生的事件，獲得有關經過的生物、天氣及其他狀況的資訊。

你也可以將因植物生長而形成的&Reference[difficultterrain]{困難地形}（例如灌木叢與矮林）轉為持續期間內的一般地形。或者，你可以將有植物存在的一般地形轉為持續期間內的困難地形。

此法術不會讓植物自行拔根移動，但植物可以為你擺動其枝條、捲鬚與莖稈。

若區域內有植物生物，你可以與其溝通，如同你們共用一種語言。

Spider Climb.name: 蛛行術
Spider Climb.description:
直到法術結束前，你觸碰的一個自願生物會獲得在垂直表面和天花板上移動的能力，且不需要佔用雙手。目標還會獲得等於其速度的攀爬速度。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就可以額外選擇一個生物。

Foundry 註記

由「施放」行動所提供的Active Effect，會將角色的攀爬速度升級為「1」，表示與（步行）速度相同。

Spike Growth.name: 荊棘叢生
Spike Growth.description:
以射程內一點為中心，半徑20呎球形區域內的地面長出堅硬的尖刺與荊棘。該區域在持續期間內成為困難地形。當生物移動進入該區域或在其中移動時，每移動5呎就會受到[[/damage 2d4 type=piercing]]傷害。

地面的變化經過偽裝，看起來像是自然形成。施放法術時看不到該區域的生物，必須採取搜索動作，並成功通過一次[[/check ability=wis skill=prc dc=@attributes.spell.dc]]或[[/check ability=wis skill=sur dc=@attributes.spell.dc]]檢定對抗你的法術豁免DC，才能在進入該區域前辨認出此地形有危險。

Spirit Guardians.name: 靈體守衛
Spirit Guardians.description:
在持續期間內，守護靈體在你周圍15呎發散區域內飛舞。若你是善良或中立，其靈體形貌會呈現為天使或精類（由你選擇）；若你是邪惡，則呈現為邪魔。

當你施放該法術時，你可以指定生物不受其影響。其他生物在該發散區域內的速度減半，且每當該發散區域進入某個生物的空間，以及每當生物進入該發散區域或在其中結束其回合時，該生物必須進行一次感知豁免。豁免失敗時，該生物承受3d8光耀傷害（若你是善良或中立）或3d8黯蝕傷害（若你是邪惡）。豁免成功時，該生物承受一半傷害。生物每回合只會進行一次此豁免。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d8。

Half Speed.description: 該生物在發散區域內的速度減半。
Half Speed.name: 速度減半

Spiritual Weapon.name: 靈體武器
Spiritual Weapon.description:
你創造出一個漂浮的幽靈力場，呈現出你所選擇的武器形狀，並持續到法術結束。這股力場會出現在射程內你所選擇的空間，你可以立即對該力場5呎內的一個生物發動一次近戰法術攻擊。命中時，目標承受1d8 + 你的施法屬性調整值的力場傷害。

在你後續回合中作為一個附贈動作，你可以將這股力場移動至多20呎，並對其5呎內的生物再次攻擊。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d8。

Staggering Smite.name: Staggering Smite
Staggering Smite.description:
The target takes an extra 4d6 Psychic damage from the attack, and the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the &Reference[Stunned] condition until the end of your next turn.

【升環法術效應】 The extra damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 4.

Starry Wisp.name: 點點星芒
Starry Wisp.description:
你向射程內的一個生物或物件發射一束光。對目標發動一次遠程法術攻擊。若命中，則目標承受1d8光耀傷害，並且直到你的下一回合結束前，其將散發出10呎微光，也無法從&Reference[Invisible]{隱形}狀態中受益。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d8、11級3d8、17級4d8。

Illuminated.description: 直到你的下一回合結束前，其將散發出10呎微光，也無法從隱形&Reference[Invisible]{隱形}狀態中受益。
Illuminated.name: 發光

Steel Wind Strike.name: Steel Wind Strike
Steel Wind Strike.description:
You flourish the weapon used in the casting and then vanish to strike like the wind. Choose up to five creatures you can see within range. Make a melee spell attack against each target. On a hit, a target takes 6d10 Force damage.

You then teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of one of the targets.

Stinking Cloud.name: 臭雲術
Stinking Cloud.description:
你以射程內一點為中心，創造一個半徑20呎、由黃色令人作嘔的氣體構成的球形區域。雲團為&Reference[heavilyobscured]{重度遮蔽}。雲團會在持續期間內滯留於空中，或直到強風（例如由@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplGustofWind]{造風術}創造的風）將其吹散。

每個在球形區域內開始其回合的生物，必須成功通過一次體質豁免，否則陷入&Reference[poisoned apply=false]{中毒}狀態，直到當前回合結束。以此方式中毒期間，該生物無法採取動作或附贈動作。

Stinking Poison.description: 以此方式陷入&Reference[poisoned apply=false]{中毒}期間，該生物無法採取動作或附贈動作。
Stinking Poison.name: 惡臭中毒

Stone Shape.name: 塑石術
Stone Shape.description: You touch a stone object of Medium size or smaller or a section of stone no more than 5 feet in any dimension and form it into any shape you like. For example, you could shape a large rock into a weapon, statue, or coffer, or you could make a small passage through a wall that is 5 feet thick. You could also shape a stone door or its frame to seal the door shut. The object you create can have up to two hinges and a latch, but finer mechanical detail isn’t possible.

Stoneskin.name: 石膚術
Stoneskin.description: 直到法術結束前，一個你所觸碰的自願生物具有對鈍擊、穿刺、劈砍傷害的&Reference[damageresistance]{抗力}。

Storm of Vengeance.name: 復仇風暴
Storm of Vengeance.description:
A churning storm cloud forms for the duration, centered on a point within range and spreading to a radius of 300 feet. Each creature under the cloud when it appears must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 2d6 Thunder damage and have the &Reference[Deafened apply=false]{耳聾} condition for the duration.

At the start of each of your later turns, the storm produces different effects, as detailed below.

Turn 2. Acidic rain falls. Each creature and object under the cloud takes 4d6 Acid damage.

Turn 3. You call six bolts of lightning from the cloud to strike six different creatures or objects beneath it. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

Turn 4. Hailstones rain down. Each creature under the cloud takes 2d6 Bludgeoning damage.

Turns 5–10. Gusts and freezing rain assail the area under the cloud. Each creature there takes 1d6 Cold damage. Until the spell ends, the area is &Reference[DifficultTerrain] and &Reference[HeavilyObscured], ranged attacks with weapons are impossible there, and strong wind blows through the area.

Turn 5+: Gusts and Rain.name: Turn 5+: Gusts and Rain
Turn 5+: Gusts and Rain.condition: at the start of your turn

Turn 4: Hailstones.condition: at the start of your turn
Turn 4: Hailstones.name: Turn 4: Hailstones

Turn 3: Lightning.condition: at the start of your turn
Turn 3: Lightning.name: Turn 3: Lightning

Turn 2: Acid Rain.name: Turn 2: Acid Rain
Turn 2: Acid Rain.condition: at the start of your turn

Suggestion.name: 暗示術
Suggestion.description:
選擇射程內你所能看見、能聽到你、並聽懂你說話的生物，你向其建議一項活動——用不超過25個單字描述。建議必須聽起來可行，並且不能涉及任何明顯會傷害目標或其盟友的行為。例如，你可以說：「去拿邪教寶庫的鑰匙，並把鑰匙給我。」或者你可以說：「停止戰鬥，靜靜離開這座圖書館，不要再回來了。」

目標必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則陷入魅惑狀態，直到法術結束，或者你或你的盟友對目標造成傷害。被魅惑的目標會盡其所能地採取建議。建議的活動可以持續整個法術持續時間，但如果建議的活動可以在較短時間內完成，則在活動完成後，結束目標身上的法術。

Pursuing Suggestion.name: 追隨建議
Pursuing Suggestion.description: 被魅惑的目標會盡其所能地採取建議。建議的活動可以持續整個法術持續時間，但如果建議的活動可以在較短時間內完成，則在活動完成後，結束目標身上的法術。

Summon Aberration.name: Summon Aberration
Summon Aberration.description:
You call forth an aberrant spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobAberrantSp]{Aberrant Spirit} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose Beholderkin, Mind Flayer, or Slaad. The creature resembles an Aberration of that kind, which determines certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, it shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the &Reference[Dodge] action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

【升環法術效應】 Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

In addition to the noted usage of the spell's level in the spirit's Traits and Actions, the following attributes are also affected.

Aberrant Spirit
AC11 + the spell’s level
HP40 + 10 for each spell level above 4
Speed30 ft.; Fly 30 ft. (hover; Beholderkin only)
PBequals your Proficiency Bonus

Summon Beast.name: 野獸召喚術
Summon Beast.description:
你喚來一個野獸靈魄。其會在射程內你所能看見的一處未佔據的空間中顯現，並使用@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobBestialSpi]{野獸靈魄}的數值面板。當你施放法術時，從天空、大地與海洋中選擇一種環境。該生物會顯化為你所選、且原生於該環境的一種動物，其數值面板中的部分細節也受此影響。該生物會在生命值降為0或法術結束時消失。

該生物是你及你盟友的盟友。戰鬥中，該生物共用你的先攻值，但會在你的回合結束後立即進行其回合。其遵從你的口頭指令（你無需花費動作）。若你沒有下達指令，其會採取迴避動作，並利用移動力遠離危險。

【升環法術效應】在數值面板中，以法術位的環階作為法術的環階。

除了靈魄的特質與動作中已註明使用法術環階之外，下列屬性也會受到影響。

野獸靈魄
AC11 + 法術環階
HP20（僅限天空）或30（僅限大地與海洋）+ 法術環階每高於2環一環加5
速度30呎；攀爬30呎（僅限大地）；飛行60呎（僅限天空）；游泳30呎（僅限海洋）
PB等同於你的熟練加值

Summon Construct.name: Summon Construct
Summon Construct.description:
You call forth the spirit of a Construct. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobConstructS]{Construct Spirit} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a material: Clay, Metal, or Stone. The creature resembles an animate statue (you determine the appearance) made of the chosen material, which determines certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the &Reference[Dodge] action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

【升環法術效應】 Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

In addition to the noted usage of the spell's level in the spirit's Traits and Actions, the following attributes are also affected.

Construct Spirit
AC13 + the spell’s level
HP40 + 15 for each spell level above 4
PBequals your Proficiency Bonus

Summon Dragon.name: Summon Dragon
Summon Dragon.description:
You call forth a Dragon spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobDraconicSp]{Draconic Spirit} stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

【升環法術效應】 Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

In addition to the noted usage of the spell's level in the spirit's Traits and Actions, the following attributes are also affected.

Draconic Spirit
AC14 + the spell’s level
HP50 + 10 for each spell level above 5
PBequals your Proficiency Bonus

Summon Elemental.name: Summon Elemental
Summon Elemental.description:
You call forth an Elemental spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobElementalS]{Elemental Spirit} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose an element: Air, Earth, Fire, or Water. The creature resembles a bipedal form wreathed in the chosen element, which determines certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the &Reference[Dodge] action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

【升環法術效應】 Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

In addition to the noted usage of the spell's level in the spirit's Traits and Actions, the following attributes are also affected.

Elemental Spirit
AC11 + the spell’s level
HP50 + 10 for each spell level above 4
Speed40 ft.; Burrow 40 ft. (Earth only); Fly 40 ft. (hover; Air only); Swim 40 ft. (Water only)
PBequals your Proficiency Bonus

Summon Fey.name: 精類召喚術
Summon Fey.description:
你喚來一個精類靈魄。其會在射程內你所能看見的一處未佔據的空間中顯現，並使用@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobFeySpirit0]{精類靈魄}的數值面板。當你施放法術時，從憤怒、歡欣與詭詐中選擇一種情緒。該生物會顯化為你所選的一種精類生物，並帶有所選情緒的特徵，其數值面板中的部分細節也受此影響。該生物會在生命值降為0或法術結束時消失。

該生物是你及你盟友的盟友。戰鬥中，該生物共用你的先攻值，但會在你的回合結束後立即進行其回合。其遵從你的口頭指令（你無需花費動作）。若你沒有下達指令，其會採取&Reference[dodge]{迴避}動作，並利用移動力遠離危險。

【升環法術效應】在數值面板中，以法術位的環階作為法術的環階。

除了靈魄的特質與動作中已註明使用法術環階之外，下列屬性也會受到影響。

精類靈魄
AC12 + 法術環階
HP30 + 法術環階每高於3環一環加10
PB等同於你的熟練加值

Summon Fiend.name: Summon Fiend
Summon Fiend.description:
You call forth a fiendish spirit. It manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobFiendishSp]{Fiendish Spirit} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose Demon, Devil, or Yugoloth. The creature resembles a Fiend of the chosen type, which determines certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the &Reference[Dodge] action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

【升環法術效應】 Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

In addition to the noted usage of the spell's level in the spirit's Traits and Actions, the following attributes are also affected.

Fiendish Spirit
AC12 + the spell’s level
HP50 (Demon only) or 40 (Devil only) or 60 (Yugoloth only) + 15 for each spell level above 6
Speed40 ft.; Climb 40 ft. (Demon only); Fly 60 ft. (Devil only)
PBequals your Proficiency Bonus

Summon Undead.name: 不死生物召喚術
Summon Undead.description:
你喚來一個不死靈魄。其會在射程內你所能看見的一處未佔據的空間中顯現，並使用@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobUndeadSpir]{不死靈魄}的數值面板。當你施放法術時，選擇該生物的形態：幽體、腐屍或骸骨。該靈魄會顯化為具有所選形態的不死生物，其數值面板中的部分細節也受此影響。該生物會在生命值降為0或法術結束時消失。

該生物是你及你盟友的盟友。戰鬥中，該生物共用你的先攻值，但會在你的回合結束後立即進行其回合。其遵從你的口頭指令（你無需花費動作）。若你沒有下達指令，其會採取迴避動作，並利用移動力遠離危險。

【升環法術效應】在數值面板中，以法術位的環階作為法術的環階。

除了靈魄的特質與動作中已註明使用法術環階之外，下列屬性也會受到影響。

不死靈魄
AC11 + 法術環階
HP30（僅限幽體與腐屍）或20（僅限骸骨）+ 法術環階每高於3環一環加10
速度30呎；飛行40呎（懸浮；僅限幽體）
PB等同於你的熟練加值

Sunbeam.name: 烈日光束
Sunbeam.description:
You launch a sunbeam in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long Line. Each creature in the Line makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d8 Radiant damage and has the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only.

Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to create a new Line of radiance.

For the duration, a mote of brilliant radiance shines above you. It sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. This light is sunlight.

Blinded.description: The target has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false]{目盲} condition until the start of your next turn.
Blinded.name: Blinded

Swift Quiver.name: Swift Quiver
Swift Quiver.description:
When you cast the spell and as a Bonus Action until it ends, you can make two attacks with a weapon that fires Arrows or Bolts, such as a Longbow or a Light Crossbow. The spell magically creates the ammunition needed for each attack. Each Arrow or Bolt created by the spell deals damage like a nonmagical piece of ammunition of its kind and disintegrates immediately after it hits or misses.

Foundry Note

The default Cast activity simply consumes a spell slot with no other effects.

The optional Cast and Enchant activity is configured to also apply an enchantment to a given weapon which removes its ammunition consumption.

Symbol.name: 徽記術
Symbol.description:
You inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface (such as a section of floor or wall) or within an object that can be closed (such as a book or chest). The glyph can cover an area no larger than 10 feet in diameter. If you choose an object, it must remain in place; if it is moved more than 10 feet from where you cast this spell, the glyph is broken, and the spell ends without being triggered.

The glyph is nearly imperceptible and requires a successful Wisdom (Perception) check against your spell save DC to notice.

When you inscribe the glyph, you set its trigger and choose which effect the symbol bears: Death, Discord, Fear, Pain, Sleep, or Stunning. Each one is explained below.

Set the Trigger. You decide what triggers the glyph when you cast the spell. For glyphs inscribed on a surface, common triggers include touching or stepping on the glyph, removing another object covering it, or approaching within a certain distance of it. For glyphs inscribed within an object, common triggers include opening that object or seeing the glyph.

You can refine the trigger so that only creatures of certain types activate it (for example, the glyph could be set to affect Aberrations). You can also set conditions for creatures that don’t trigger the glyph, such as those who say a certain password.

Once triggered, the glyph glows, filling a 60-foot-radius Sphere with Dim Light for 10 minutes, after which time the spell ends. Each creature in the Sphere when the glyph activates is targeted by its effect, as is a creature that enters the Sphere for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature is targeted only once per turn.

Death. Each target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d10 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful save.

Discord. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target argues with other creatures for 1 minute. During this time, it is incapable of meaningful communication and has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

Fear. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened, the target must move at least 30 feet away from the glyph on each of its turns, if able.

Pain. Each target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Incapacitated condition for 1 minute.

Sleep. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Unconscious condition for 10 minutes. A creature awakens if it takes damage or if someone takes an action to shake it awake.

Stunning. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or have the Stunned condition for 1 minute.

Sleeping.name: 睡眠
Sleeping.description: A creature awakens if it takes damage or if someone takes an action to shake it awake.

Arguing.name: Arguing
Arguing.description: The target is incapable of meaningful communication and has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

Frightened.description: While Frightened, the target must move at least 30 feet away from the glyph on each of its turns, if able.
Frightened.name: Frightened

Synaptic Static.name: Synaptic Static
Synaptic Static.description:
You cause psychic energy to erupt at a point within range. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on that point makes an Intelligence saving throw, taking 8d6 Psychic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

On a failed save, a target also has muddled thoughts for 1 minute. During that time, it subtracts [[/r 1d6]] from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as any Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration. The target makes an [[/save ability=int dc=@attributes.spelldc format=long]] at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Muddled Thoughts.name: Muddled Thoughts
Muddled Thoughts.description: The target subtracts 1d6 from all its attack rolls and ability checks, as well as any Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration. The target makes an [[/save ability=int format=long]] at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron.name: Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron
Tasha's Bubbling Cauldron.description:
You conjure a claw-footed cauldron filled with bubbling liquid. The cauldron appears in an unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet of you and lasts for the duration. The cauldron can’t be moved and disappears when the spell ends, along with the bubbling liquid inside it.

The liquid in the cauldron duplicates the properties of a Common or an Uncommon potion of your choice (such as a @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.equipment.Item.phbagPotionofHea]{Potion of Healing}). As a Bonus Action, you or an ally can reach into the cauldron and withdraw one potion of that kind. The potion is contained in a vial that disappears when the potion is consumed. The cauldron can produce a number of these potions equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 1). When the last of these potions is withdrawn from the cauldron, the cauldron disappears, and the spell ends.

Potions obtained from the cauldron that aren’t consumed disappear when you cast this spell again.

Foundry Note

The Limited Uses of this spell represent the number of potions remaining in the cauldron, which is reset by the Create Cauldron activity.

The optional Withdraw Potion activity will consume a use of the cauldron.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.name: 塔莎狂笑術
Tasha's Hideous Laughter.description:
選擇射程內一個你所能看見的生物，進行一次感知豁免。豁免失敗時，其在法術持續時間內陷入&Reference[prone apply=false]{伏地}與&Reference[incapacitated apply=false]{無力}狀態。在持續期間內，若其能笑，則會不受控制地笑出來，並且無法自行解除伏地狀態。

在其每回合結束和每次承受傷害時，再次進行[[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spelldc]]豁免。若豁免因承受傷害而觸發，則目標在豁免上具有優勢。豁免成功時，法術結束。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，就可以額外選擇一個生物。

Uncontrollable Laughter.name: 壓抑不住的狂笑
Uncontrollable Laughter.description:
在法術持續時間內陷入&Reference[prone apply=false]{伏地}和&Reference[incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態。在持續期間內，若其能笑，則會不受控制地笑出來，並且無法自行解除伏地狀態。

在其每回合結束和每次承受傷害時，再次進行[[/save ability=wis dc=@attributes.spelldc]]豁免。若豁免因承受傷害而觸發，則目標在豁免上具有優勢。豁免成功時，法術結束。

Telekinesis.name: 心靈遙控
Telekinesis.description:
You gain the ability to move or manipulate creatures or objects by thought. When you cast the spell and as a Magic action on your later turns before the spell ends, you can exert your will on one creature or object that you can see within range, causing the appropriate effect below. You can affect the same target round after round or choose a new one at any time. If you switch targets, the prior target is no longer affected by the spell.

Creature. You can try to move a Huge or smaller creature. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or you move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell’s range. Until the end of your next turn, the creature has the &Reference[Restrained] condition, and if you lift it into the air, it is suspended there. It falls at the end of your next turn unless you use this option on it again and it fails the save.

Object. You can try to move a Huge or smaller object. If the object isn’t being worn or carried, you automatically move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell’s range.

If the object is worn or carried by a creature, that creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw, or you pull the object away and move it up to 30 feet in any direction within the spell’s range.

You can exert fine control on objects with your telekinetic grip, such as manipulating a simple tool, opening a door or a container, stowing or retrieving an item from an open container, or pouring the contents from a vial.

Telepathy.name: Telepathy
Telepathy.description:
You create a telepathic link between yourself and a willing creature with which you are familiar. The creature can be anywhere on the same plane of existence as you. The spell ends if you or the target are no longer on the same plane.

Until the spell ends, you and the target can instantly share words, images, sounds, and other sensory messages with each other through the link, and the target recognizes you as the creature it is communicating with. The spell enables a creature to understand the meaning of your words and any sensory messages you send to it.

Teleport.name: 傳送術
Teleport.description:
This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select. If you target an object, it must be Large or smaller, and it can’t be held or carried by an unwilling creature.

The destination you choose must be known to you, and it must be on the same plane of existence as you. Your familiarity with the destination determines whether you arrive there successfully. The DM rolls [[/gmr 1d100]] and consults the Teleportation Outcome table and the explanations after it.

@UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.tables.RollTable.phbsplTeleportMi]{Teleportation Outcome}
FamiliarityMishapSimilar AreaOff TargetOn Target
Permanent circle———01–00
Linked object———01–00
Very familiar01–0506–1314–2425–00
Seen casually01–3334–4344–5354–00
Viewed once or described01–4344–5354–7374–00
False destination01–5051–00——

Familiarity. Here are the meanings of the terms in the table’s Familiarity column:

  • “Permanent circle” means a permanent teleportation circle whose sigil sequence you know.
  • “Linked object” means you possess an object taken from the desired destination within the last six months, such as a book from a wizard’s library.
  • “Very familiar” is a place you have visited often, a place you have carefully studied, or a place you can see when you cast the spell.
  • “Seen casually” is a place you have seen more than once but with which you aren’t very familiar.
  • “Viewed once or described” is a place you have seen once, possibly using magic, or a place you know through someone else’s description, perhaps from a map.
  • “False destination” is a place that doesn’t exist. Perhaps you tried to scry an enemy’s sanctum but instead viewed an illusion, or you are attempting to teleport to a location that no longer exists.

Mishap. The spell’s unpredictable magic results in a difficult journey. Each teleporting creature (or the target object) takes [[/damage 3d10 type=force]] damage, and the DM rerolls on the table to see where you wind up (multiple mishaps can occur, dealing damage each time).

Similar Area. You and your group (or the target object) appear in a different area that’s visually or thematically similar to the target area. You appear in the closest similar place. If you are heading for your home laboratory, for example, you might appear in another person’s laboratory in the same city.

Off Target. You and your group (or the target object) appear [[/r 2d12]] miles away from the destination in a random direction. Roll [[/r 1d8]] for the direction: 1, east; 2, southeast; 3, south; 4, southwest; 5, west; 6, northwest; 7, north; or 8, northeast.

On Target. You and your group (or the target object) appear where you intended.

Teleportation Circle.name: 傳送法陣
Teleportation Circle.description:
As you cast the spell, you draw a 5-foot-radius circle on the ground inscribed with sigils that link your location to a permanent teleportation circle of your choice whose sigil sequence you know and that is on the same plane of existence as you. A shimmering portal opens within the circle you drew and remains open until the end of your next turn. Any creature that enters the portal instantly appears within 5 feet of the destination circle or in the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.

Many major temples, guildhalls, and other important places have permanent teleportation circles. Each circle includes a unique sigil sequence—a string of runes arranged in a particular pattern.

When you first gain the ability to cast this spell, you learn the sigil sequences for two destinations on the Material Plane, determined by the DM. You might learn additional sigil sequences during your adventures. You can commit a new sigil sequence to memory after studying it for 1 minute.

You can create a permanent teleportation circle by casting this spell in the same location every day for 365 days.

Tenser's Floating Disk.name: 譚森浮碟術
Tenser's Floating Disk.description:
此法術在射程內一處你所選且能看見的未佔據空間內創造出一個水平的圓形力場。其有著3呎直徑，厚1吋，且漂浮於離地3呎的位置。這個浮碟在法術持續期間將維持存在，且可以承擔至多500磅的重量。若放置超過此重量的物品，法術便會終止，浮碟上的所有東西都會掉落至地面。

當你距離浮碟20呎以內時，其會靜止不動。若你移動到距離其超過20呎的地方，浮碟會跟隨你，使其與你的距離保持在20呎以內。其可以越過崎嶇的地形、上下樓梯、斜坡等，但無法跨越高度變化達10呎或以上的地形。例如，浮碟無法越過一個10呎深的坑，若其是在坑底被創造出來的，也無法離開該坑。

如果你移動到距離浮碟超過100呎的地方（通常是因為其無法繞過障礙物來跟隨你），法術便會終止。

Thaumaturgy.name: 奇術
Thaumaturgy.description:
你在射程內顯現出一個小小的奇蹟。你在射程內創造以下效果之一。若你多次施放此法術，則你最多可以同時讓三種持續1分鐘的效果處於啟動狀態。

【變化眼眸】你可以改變你眼睛的外觀，持續1分鐘。

【放大聲音】你的聲音比正常聲音大三倍，持續1分鐘。在持續期間內，你在 [[/check ability=cha skill=itm]]檢定上具有優勢。

【玩火】你可以讓火焰閃爍、變亮、變暗或改變顏色，持續1分鐘。

【無形之手】你瞬間使一個未上鎖的門窗突然開啟或猛然關閉。

【幻音】你在射程內你所選擇的一點創造出一個瞬間的聲音，比如雷聲隆隆、烏鴉喳喳或低語切切。

【微震】你在地面上引發一陣無害的震動，持續1分鐘。

Booming Voice.description: Your voice booms up to three times as loud as normal for 1 minute. For the duration, you have Advantage on [[/check ability=cha skill=itm]] checks.
Booming Voice.name: Booming Voice

Thorn Whip.name: 荊棘之鞭
Thorn Whip.description:
你創造一條覆蓋著荊棘的藤蔓般的鞭子，在你的指揮下向射程內一個生物揮去。對目標發動近戰法術攻擊。命中時，目標承受1d6穿刺傷害，且若目標是大型或更小的生物，則你可以將其拉向你最多10呎。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d6、11級3d6、17級4d6。

Thunderclap.name: 鳴雷破
Thunderclap.description:
每個處於你5呎擴散區域內的生物必須成功通過一次體質豁免，否則承受1d6的雷鳴傷害。法術產生的雷鳴聲可以在100呎遠的地方聽到。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d6、11級3d6、17級4d6。

Thunderous Smite.name: 雷鳴斬
Thunderous Smite.description:
你的攻擊伴隨著300呎內皆可聽見的雷鳴聲，且目標在該攻擊中額外承受2d6雷鳴傷害。此外，若目標是生物，其必須成功通過一次力量豁免，否則將被向遠離你的方向推開10呎，並陷入&Reference[prone apply=false]{伏地}狀態。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d6。

Prone.description: 因被推開10呎，目標陷入&Reference[prone apply=false]{伏地}狀態。
Prone.name: 伏地

Thunderwave.name: 雷鳴波
Thunderwave.description:
你釋放出一波雷鳴能量。以你為原點的15呎立方區域內，每個生物進行一次體質豁免。豁免失敗時，生物承受2d8雷鳴傷害，並被推離你10呎遠。豁免成功時，該生物只會承受一半的傷害。

此外，完全處於立方區域內、沒有固定住的物體，都會被推離10呎遠，而雷鳴聲在300呎內都能聽到。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d8。

Time Stop.name: 時間停止
Time Stop.description:
你短暫地停止除了你之外所有人的時間流動。其他生物的時間停止流逝，而你則連續採取1d4 + 1回合，在這段期間你可以正常地使用動作和移動。

若你在這段期間使用其中一個動作或任何創造出的效果影響了一個除你以外的生物、或一個被你以外的人穿戴或攜帶的物品，則此法術結束。此外，該法術也會在你移動到一處距離你施法地點超過1,000呎的地點時結束。

Toll the Dead.name: 亡者喪鐘
Toll the Dead.description:
你指向射程內一名你所能看見的生物，目標將聽到 10 尺內某處傳來的悲戚鐘聲。目標必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則承受1d8黯蝕傷害。若目標失去過任何生命值，則承受1d12黯蝕傷害。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5 級 2d8 或 2d12、11 級 3d8 或 3d12、17 級 4d8 或 4d12。

Damaged Target.name: 受傷目標
Damaged Target.target: creature missing any of its Hit Points

Tongues.name: 巧舌術
Tongues.description: 此法術賦予你觸碰的生物理解其所聽見或看見的任何口語或手語的能力。此外，當目標以說話或手語溝通時，任何至少通曉一種語言的生物，只要能聽見其說話或看見其手語，就能理解目標。

Transport via Plants.name: 植物遁走術
Transport via Plants.description: 此法術將在一個射程內，體型為大型或更大的非活化植物與另一個處於相同存在位面，位於任意距離外的植物之間創造一道魔法連結。你必須曾經見過或碰觸過做為目的地的植物至少一次。在法術持續期間，任何生物都可以走進目標植物，並使用5呎移動速度從目的地植物走出。

Tree Stride.name: 樹躍術
Tree Stride.description:
You gain the ability to enter a tree and move from inside it to inside another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. Both trees must be living and at least the same size as you. You must use 5 feet of movement to enter a tree. You instantly know the location of all other trees of the same kind within 500 feet and, as part of the move used to enter the tree, can either pass into one of those trees or step out of the tree you’re in. You appear in a spot of your choice within 5 feet of the destination tree, using another 5 feet of movement. If you have no movement left, you appear within 5 feet of the tree you entered.

You can use this transportation ability only once on each of your turns. You must end each turn outside a tree.

True Polymorph.name: 完全變形術
True Polymorph.description:
Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range. The creature shape-shifts into a different creature or a nonmagical object, or the object shape-shifts into a creature (the object must be neither worn nor carried). The transformation lasts for the duration or until the target dies or is destroyed, but if you maintain Concentration on this spell for the full duration, the spell lasts until dispelled.

An unwilling creature can make a Wisdom saving throw, and if it succeeds, it isn’t affected by this spell.

Creature into Creature. If you turn a creature into another kind of creature, the new form can be any kind you choose that has a Challenge Rating equal to or less than the target’s Challenge Rating or level. The target’s game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the new form, but it retains its Hit Points, Hit Point Dice, alignment, and personality.

The target gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Points of the new form.

The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the anatomy of its new form, and it can’t speak or cast spells.

The target’s gear melds into the new form. The creature can’t use or otherwise benefit from any of that equipment.

Object into Creature. You can turn an object into any kind of creature, as long as the creature’s size is no larger than the object’s size and the creature has a Challenge Rating of 9 or lower. The creature is Friendly to you and your allies. In combat, it takes its turns immediately after yours, and it obeys your commands.

If the spell lasts more than an hour, you no longer control the creature. It might remain Friendly to you, depending on how you have treated it.

Creature into Object. If you turn a creature into an object, it transforms along with whatever it is wearing and carrying into that form, as long as the object’s size is no larger than the creature’s size. The creature’s statistics become those of the object, and the creature has no memory of time spent in this form after the spell ends and it returns to normal.

True Resurrection.name: 完全復活術
True Resurrection.description:
You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that died for any reason except old age. The creature is revived with all its Hit Points.

This spell closes all wounds, neutralizes any poison, cures all magical contagions, and lifts any curses affecting the creature when it died. The spell replaces damaged or missing organs and limbs. If the creature was Undead, it is restored to its non-Undead form.

The spell can provide a new body if the original no longer exists, in which case you must speak the creature’s name. The creature then appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 10 feet of you.

True Seeing.name: 真知術
True Seeing.description: For the duration, the willing creature you touch has Truesight with a range of 120 feet.

True Strike.name: 克敵機先
True Strike.description:
在魔法洞察的閃光引導下，你以施法時所用的武器進行一次攻擊。該攻擊的攻擊檢定與傷害骰使用你的施法屬性計算，而非使用力量或敏捷屬性。若攻擊造成傷害，則可以造成光耀傷害，或該武器的普通傷害類型（由你選擇）。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時，無論你所選擇造成的是光耀傷害還是武器原本的傷害類型，該法術都會額外造成光耀傷害：5級1d6、11級2d6、17級3d6。

Tsunami.name: Tsunami
Tsunami.description:
A wall of water springs into existence at a point you choose within range. You can make the wall up to 300 feet long, 300 feet high, and 50 feet thick. The wall lasts for the duration.

When the wall appears, each creature in its area makes a Strength saving throw, taking 6d10 Bludgeoning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

At the start of each of your turns after the wall appears, the wall, along with any creatures in it, moves 50 feet away from you. Any Huge or smaller creature inside the wall or whose space the wall enters when it moves must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 5d10 Bludgeoning damage. A creature can take this damage only once per round. At the end of the turn, the wall’s height is reduced by 50 feet, and the damage the wall deals on later rounds is reduced by 1d10. When the wall reaches 0 feet in height, the spell ends.

A creature caught in the wall can move by swimming. Because of the wave’s force, though, the creature must succeed on a [[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spelldc]] check against your spell save DC to move at all. If it fails the check, it can’t move. A creature that moves out of the wall falls to the ground.

Foundry Note

The limited uses value of this spell tracks the number of rounds remaining from its initial 6, which is reset as part of the Create Tsunami activity.

The Start of Turn Effects activity consumes one use to represent one round passing and uses the updated count for its damage rolls.

Start of Turn Effects.name: Start of Turn Effects
Start of Turn Effects.condition: start of each of your turns

Unseen Servant.name: 隱形僕役
Unseen Servant.description:
此法術創造出一個隱形、無心智、無形體的中型力場。直到法術結束前，其能聽從你的命令進行簡單的工作。該僕役會被創造在施法距離內一處未佔據的地面上。其AC為10，具有1生命值，力量為2，且不能攻擊。若僕役的生命值降至0，則法術終止。

每回合一次，你可以採取附贈動作在心靈上命令僕役移動至多15呎並與一個物件進行互動。僕役可以做人類能做到的簡單工作，例如拿取東西、打掃、修補、摺疊衣物、點火、上菜及倒飲料。一旦你下達命令，僕役就會盡其所能地執行任務直到完成，然後等待你的下一個命令。

如果你命令僕役執行的任務需要其移動到距離你超過60呎的地方，則法術終止。

Vampiric Touch.name: 吸血鬼之觸
Vampiric Touch.description:
你以陰影纏繞的手觸碰，能從他人身上吸取生命力來治療自己的傷勢。對觸及範圍內的一個生物進行一次近戰法術攻擊。命中時，目標承受3d6黯蝕傷害，而你恢復等同於所造成黯蝕傷害一半的生命值。

直到法術結束前，你可以在每個你的回合以魔法動作再次進行該攻擊，目標可以是同一個生物或另一個生物。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d6。

Vicious Mockery.name: 惡毒嘲笑
Vicious Mockery.description:
你選擇射程內一名你所能看見或聽見的生物，對其拋出一連串帶著精妙魔力的冒犯之語。目標必須成功通過感知豁免檢定，否則承受 1d6 心靈傷害，並在其下個回合結束前的下一次攻擊檢定中具有劣勢。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5 級 2d6、11 級 3d6、17 級 4d6。

Mocked.name: 嘲笑
Mocked.description: 目標在其下個回合結束前的下一次攻擊檢定中具有劣勢。

Vitriolic Sphere.name: Vitriolic Sphere
Vitriolic Sphere.description:
You point at a location within range, and a glowing, 1-foot-diameter ball of acid streaks there and explodes in a 20-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10d4 Acid damage and another [[/damage 5d4 type=acid]] damage at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half the initial damage only.

【升環法術效應】 The initial damage increases by 2d4 for each spell slot level above 4.

Lingering Acid.description: The creature takes [[/damage 5d4 type=acid]] damage at the end of its next turn
Lingering Acid.name: Lingering Acid

Wall of Fire.name: 火牆術
Wall of Fire.description:
You create a wall of fire on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for the duration.

When the wall appears, each creature in its area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 5d8 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, deals 5d8 Fire damage to each creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of that side or inside the wall. A creature takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The other side of the wall deals no damage.

【升環法術效應】 The damage increases by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 4.

Wall of Force.name: 力牆術
Wall of Force.description:
An Invisible wall of force springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall appears in any orientation you choose, as a horizontal or vertical barrier or at an angle. It can be free floating or resting on a solid surface. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a globe with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1/4 inch thick and lasts for the duration. If the wall cuts through a creature’s space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side).

Nothing can physically pass through the wall. It is immune to all damage and can’t be dispelled by @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{Dispel Magic}. A @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.spells.Item.phbsplDisintegra]{Disintegrate} spell destroys the wall instantly, however. The wall also extends into the Ethereal Plane and blocks ethereal travel through the wall.

Wall of Ice.name: 冰牆術
Wall of Ice.description:
You create a wall of ice on a solid surface within range. You can form it into a hemispherical dome or a globe with a radius of up to 10 feet, or you can shape a flat surface made up of ten 10-foot-square panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. In any form, the wall is 1 foot thick and lasts for the duration.

If the wall cuts through a creature’s space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side) and makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

The wall is an object that can be damaged and thus breached. It has AC 12 and 30 Hit Points per 10-foot section, and it has Immunity to Cold, Poison, and Psychic damage and Vulnerability to Fire damage. Reducing a 10-foot section of wall to 0 Hit Points destroys it and leaves behind a sheet of frigid air in the space the wall occupied.

A creature moving through the sheet of frigid air for the first time on a turn makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 5d6 Cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

【升環法術效應】 The damage the wall deals when it appears increases by 2d6 and the damage from passing through the sheet of frigid air increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 6.

Frigid Air.condition: creature moves through the wall for the first time on a turn
Frigid Air.name: Frigid Air

Wall of Thorns.name: 棘牆術
Wall of Thorns.description:
You create a wall of tangled brush bristling with needle-sharp thorns. The wall appears within range on a solid surface and lasts for the duration. You choose to make the wall up to 60 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick or a circle that has a 20-foot diameter and is up to 20 feet high and 5 feet thick. The wall blocks line of sight.

When the wall appears, each creature in its area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d8 Piercing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

A creature can move through the wall, albeit slowly and painfully. For every 1 foot a creature moves through the wall, it must spend 4 feet of movement. Furthermore, the first time a creature enters a space in the wall on a turn or ends its turn there, the creature makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d8 Slashing damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

【升環法術效應】 Both types of damage increase by 1d8 for each spell slot level above 6.

Traversal Save.name: Traversal Save
Traversal Save.condition: first time a creature enters or ends its turn in the wall

Warding Bond.name: 守護聯結
Warding Bond.description:
你觸碰另一個自願的生物，並在你與目標之間建立一道神祕的聯結，直到法術結束。當目標位於你60呎內時，其AC和豁免檢定獲得+1加值，且對所有傷害具有&Reference[damageresistance]{抗力}。此外，每當其受到傷害時，你也會受到等量的傷害。

若你的生命值降至0，或你與目標相隔超過60呎，法術就會結束。若法術被再次施放在任一受聯結的生物身上，法術也會結束。

Bonded.name: 受聯結
Bonded.description:
當目標位於你60呎內時，其AC和豁免檢定獲得+1加值，且對所有傷害具有抗力。此外，每當其受到傷害時，你也會受到等量的傷害。

若你的生命值降至0，或你與目標相隔超過60呎，法術就會結束。若法術被再次施放在任一受聯結的生物身上，法術也會結束。

Water Breathing.name: 水下呼吸
Water Breathing.description: 此法術賦予射程內至多十個你所選的自願生物在水下呼吸的能力，直到法術結束前。受影響的生物也保有其正常的呼吸方式。

Water Walk.name: 水面行走
Water Walk.description:
此法術賦予在任何液體表面（例如水、強酸、泥漿、雪、流沙或熔岩）上移動的能力，如同走在無害的堅固地面（穿越熔岩的生物仍可能受到高熱傷害）。射程內至多十個你所選的自願生物會在持續期間內獲得此能力。

受影響的目標必須採取附贈動作，才能從液體表面進入液體內部，反之亦然；但若目標墜入液體中，則會穿過表面進入下方的液體。

Water Walking.description: 受影響的目標必須採取附贈動作，才能從液體表面進入液體內部，反之亦然；但若目標墜入液體中，則會穿過表面進入下方的液體。
Water Walking.name: 水面行走

Web.name: 蛛網術
Web.description:
你在射程內一點召喚出一大團黏稠的蛛網。蛛網會在持續期間內填滿該處一個20呎立方體區域。蛛網為&Reference[difficultterrain]{困難地形}，且網內的區域為&Reference[lightlyobscured]{輕度遮蔽}。

若蛛網未被固定在兩個固體（例如牆壁或樹木）之間，或未鋪設在地板、牆壁或天花板上，蛛網就會自行坍塌，法術在你的下一回合開始時結束。鋪設在平面上的蛛網深度為5呎。

生物在一回合內第一次進入蛛網，或在蛛網中開始其回合時，必須成功通過一次敏捷豁免，否則在蛛網中期間或直到掙脫前，陷入&Reference[restrained]{束縛}狀態。

被蛛網束縛的生物可以採取一個動作，進行一次[[/check ability=str skill=ath dc=@attributes.spell.dc]]檢定對抗你的法術豁免DC。若成功，其不再受到束縛。

蛛網是易燃的。任何暴露在火焰中的5呎立方體蛛網會在1輪內燒盡，並對在火焰中開始其回合的生物造成[[/damage 2d4 type=fire]]傷害。

Weird.name: 怪影殺手
Weird.description:
You try to create illusory terrors in others’ minds. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within range makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 10d10 Psychic damage and has the &Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐懼} condition for the duration. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage only.

A Frightened target makes a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns. On a failed save, it takes [[/damage 5d10 type=psychic]] damage. On a successful save, the spell ends on that target.

End of Turn Save.condition: at the end of each affected creature's turn
End of Turn Save.name: End of Turn Save

Frightening Terrors.name: Frightening Terrors
Frightening Terrors.description: A &Reference[Frightened apply=false]{恐懼} target makes a [[/save ability=wis format=long]] at the end of each of its turns. On a failed save, it takes [[/damage 5d10 type=psychic]] damage. On a successful save, the spell ends on that target.

Wind Walk.name: 御風而行
Wind Walk.description:
You and up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range assume gaseous forms for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud. While in this cloud form, a target has a Fly Speed of 300 feet and can hover; it has Immunity to the Prone condition; and it has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. The only actions a target can take in this form are the &Reference[Dash] action or a Magic action to begin reverting to its normal form. Reverting takes 1 minute, during which the target has the &Reference[Stunned apply=false] condition. Until the spell ends, the target can revert to cloud form, which also requires a Magic action followed by a 1-minute transformation.

If a target is in cloud form and flying when the effect ends, the target descends 60 feet per round for 1 minute until it lands, which it does safely. If it can’t land after 1 minute, it falls the remaining distance.

Cloud Form.description: The only actions a target can take in this form are the &Reference[Dash] action or a Magic action to begin reverting to its normal form. Reverting takes 1 minute, during which the target has the &Reference[Stunned apply=false] condition. Until the spell ends, the target can revert to cloud form, which also requires a Magic action followed by a 1-minute transformation.
Cloud Form.name: Cloud Form

Wind Wall.name: 風牆術
Wind Wall.description:
一道強風構成的牆從射程內你所選的一點由地面升起。你可以使這道牆長達50呎、高15呎、厚1呎。只要牆沿著地面形成一條連續的路徑，你可以任意塑造其形狀。牆會在持續期間內存在。

當牆出現時，其區域內的每個生物都進行一次力量豁免，豁免失敗時承受4d8鈍擊傷害，成功時傷害減半。

強風使霧、煙與其他氣體無法穿過。小型或更小的飛行生物或物體無法穿過這道牆。被帶入牆內的鬆散輕質材料會向上飛起。朝牆後目標射出的箭矢、弩矢與其他一般投射物會被向上偏折而自動未命中。巨人投擲的巨石、攻城器械與類似的投射物則不受影響。處於氣態的生物無法穿過這道牆。

Wish.name: 祈願術
Wish.description:
Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter reality itself.

The basic use of this spell is to duplicate any other spell of level 8 or lower. If you use it this way, you don’t need to meet any requirements to cast that spell, including costly components. The spell simply takes effect.

Alternatively, you can create one of the following effects of your choice:

Object Creation. You create one object of up to 25,000 GP in value that isn’t a magic item. The object can be no more than 300 feet in any dimension, and it appears in an unoccupied space that you can see on the ground.

Instant Health. You allow yourself and up to twenty creatures that you can see to regain all Hit Points, and you end all effects on them listed in the Greater Restoration spell.

Resistance. You grant up to ten creatures that you can see Resistance to one damage type that you choose. This Resistance is permanent.

Spell Immunity. You grant up to ten creatures you can see immunity to a single spell or other magical effect for 8 hours.

Sudden Learning. You replace one of your feats with another feat for which you are eligible. You lose all the benefits of the old feat and gain the benefits of the new one. You can’t replace a feat that is a prerequisite for any of your other feats or features.

Roll Redo. You undo a single recent event by forcing a reroll of any die roll made within the last round (including your last turn). Reality reshapes itself to accommodate the new result. For example, a Wish spell could undo an ally’s failed saving throw or a foe’s Critical Hit. You can force the reroll to be made with Advantage or Disadvantage, and you choose whether to use the reroll or the original roll.

Reshape Reality. You may wish for something not included in any of the other effects. To do so, state your wish to the DM as precisely as possible. The DM has great latitude in ruling what occurs in such an instance; the greater the wish, the greater the likelihood that something goes wrong. This spell might simply fail, the effect you desire might be achieved only in part, or you might suffer an unforeseen consequence as a result of how you worded the wish. For example, wishing that a villain were dead might propel you forward in time to a period when that villain is no longer alive, effectively removing you from the game. Similarly, wishing for a Legendary magic item or an Artifact might instantly transport you to the presence of the item’s current owner. If your wish is granted and its effects have consequences for a whole community, region, or world, you are likely to attract powerful foes. If your wish would affect a god, the god’s divine servants might instantly intervene to prevent it or to encourage you to craft the wish in a particular way. If your wish would undo the multiverse itself, threaten the City of Sigil, or affect the Lady of Pain in any way, you see an image of her in your mind for a moment; she shakes her head, and your wish fails.

The stress of casting Wish to produce any effect other than duplicating another spell weakens you. After enduring that stress, each time you cast a spell until you finish a Long Rest, you take 1d10 Necrotic damage per level of that spell. This damage can’t be reduced or prevented in any way. In addition, your Strength score becomes 3 for 2d4 days. For each of those days that you spend resting and doing nothing more than light activity, your remaining recovery time decreases by 2 days. Finally, there is a [[/r 1d3cs1]]{33 percent chance} that you are unable to cast Wish ever again if you suffer this stress.

Wish Stress.name: Wish Stress
Wish Stress.description: Each time you cast a spell until you finish a Long Rest, you take [[/damage 1d10 type=necrotic]] damage per level of that spell. This damage can’t be reduced or prevented in any way. In addition, your Strength score becomes 3 for [[/r 2d4]] days.

Witch Bolt.name: 巫術箭
Witch Bolt.description:
一束爆裂的能量光束射向射程內的一名生物，在你與目標之間形成一道持續的閃電弧。你對目標進行一次遠程法術攻擊。 命中時目標承受2d12閃電傷害。

即使首次攻擊失手，你在此後的每個回合中仍可以執行附贈動作，對目標造成 1d12 閃電傷害。

若目標離開法術的射程，或相對你處於&Reference[totalcover]{全掩蔽}，則法術終止。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，初始傷害就增加 1d12。

Sustained Lightning.description:
即使首次攻擊失手，你在此後的每個回合中仍可以執行附贈動作，對目標造成 [[/damage 1d12 type=lightning]]傷害。

若目標離開法術的射程，或相對你處於&Reference[totalcover]{全掩蔽}，則法術終止。
Sustained Lightning.name: 持續閃電

Word of Radiance.name: 光耀禱詞
Word of Radiance.description:
灼熱的光輝在你周圍5呎擴散區域內爆發而出。區域內每個你所選擇且能看見的生物必須成功通過一次體質豁免檢定，否則承受1d6光耀傷害。

【戲法升級】當你達到特定等級時傷害增加：5級2d6、11級3d6、17級4d6。

Word of Recall.name: 回返真言
Word of Recall.description:
You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary. You and any creatures that teleport with you appear in the nearest unoccupied space to the spot you designated when you prepared your sanctuary (see below). If you cast this spell without first preparing a sanctuary, the spell has no effect.

You must designate a location, such as a temple, as a sanctuary by casting this spell there.

Wrathful Smite.name: 激憤斬
Wrathful Smite.description:
目標會在該攻擊中額外承受1d6暗蝕傷害，且其必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則在法術終止前陷入&Reference[frightened apply=false]{恐懼}狀態。受恐懼的目標每個回合結束時，重複該豁免，豁免成功時終止在其身上的法術。

【升環法術效應】 法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d6。

Frightened.description: 目標直到法術結束前陷入&Reference[frightened apply=false]{恐懼}狀態。受恐懼的目標每個回合結束時，其重複[[/save ability=wis]]豁免，若豁免成功則結束此法術對自身的影響。
Frightened.name: 恐懼

Yolande's Regal Presence.name: Yolande's Regal Presence
Yolande's Regal Presence.description: You surround yourself with unearthly majesty in a 10-foot Emanation. Whenever the Emanation enters the space of a creature you can see and whenever a creature you can see enters the Emanation or ends its turn there, you can force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes 4d6 Psychic damage and has the &Reference[Prone] condition, and you can push it up to 10 feet away. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage only. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

Emanation Save.condition: a creature is within the Emanation
Emanation Save.name: Emanation Save

Zone of Truth.name: 誠實之域
Zone of Truth.description:
你創造一個以射程內一點為中心，半徑15呎抵禦謊言的球形魔法區域。直到法術結束前，生物在一個回合內第一次進入法術區域，或在區域內開始其回合時，進行一次魅力豁免檢定。豁免失敗時，在半徑內的生物不能故意說謊。你可以知曉生物的豁免成功與否。

受影響的生物可以意識到法術的存在，且可以主動迴避回答那些通常會以謊言答覆的問題。例如生物在回答問題時可以閃爍其詞，但必須是誠實的。

Cannot Lie.name: 不能說謊
Cannot Lie.description:
豁免失敗時，在半徑內的生物不能故意說謊。你可以知曉生物的豁免成功與否。

受影響的生物可以意識到法術的存在，且可以主動迴避回答那些通常會以謊言答覆的問題。例如生物在回答問題時可以閃爍其詞，但必須是誠實的。

Dominate Beast.name: 支配野獸
Dominate Beast.description:
射程內一名你所能看見的野獸必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則在持續期間內陷入&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態。若你或你的盟友正在與其戰鬥，目標進行該豁免時具有優勢。每當目標承受傷害，其重複該豁免，成功時目標身上的法術結束。

只要你與陷入魅惑狀態的目標位於同一存在位面，你們之間就有心靈感應連結。在你的回合，你可以透過此連結向目標下達命令（無需動作），例如「攻擊那名生物」、「移動到那裡」或「拿那件物品來」。目標會在其回合盡力服從。若目標完成一項命令，且未收到你的進一步指示，其便依自己的喜好行動與移動，並著重保護自己。

你可以命令目標採取反應，但你必須為此採取自己的反應。

【升環法術效應】使用5環法術位時，你的專注可以持續至多10分鐘；6環法術位時至多1小時；7環或更高環階法術位時至多8小時。

Dominated.description: 每當陷入&Reference[Charmed apply=false]{魅惑}狀態的目標承受傷害，其重複該感知[[/save ability=wis]]豁免，成功時目標身上的法術結束。
Dominated.name: 受支配

Cloud of Daggers.name: 匕首之雲
Cloud of Daggers.description:
你在射程內一點為中心的5呎立方區域內召喚出旋轉的匕首。每個處於該區域內的生物承受4d4點揮砍傷害。若生物進入該立方體、在該處結束其回合，或該立方體移動至其所在空間時，同樣會承受此傷害。一個生物每回合只會承受一次此傷害。

在你後續回合中，你可以採取一個魔法動作，將立方體傳送最多30呎。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加2d4。

Mage Hand.name: 法師之手
Mage Hand.description:
一個幽靈般漂浮的手掌出現在你所選擇的範圍內的某個點。手掌持續存在直到法術結束。若其距離你超過30呎，或你再次施放此法術，其將消失。

當你施放法術時，你可以使用這隻手操作一個物體、打開未上鎖的門或容器、從開放的容器中取出或放入物品， 或者將液體從瓶子中倒出

在你後續的回合中做為一個魔法動作，你可以再次控制這隻手做這些事作為動作的一部分，你可以將手移動至多30呎。

手無法攻擊、啟動魔法物品或攜帶超過10磅的物品。

Hail of Thorns.name: 棘刺雹
Hail of Thorns.description:
當你命中生物時，此法術會從你的遠程武器或彈藥中創造出一陣荊棘之雨。攻擊的目標以及其5呎範圍內的每個生物進行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失敗時承受1d10穿刺傷害，成功時傷害減半。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，傷害就增加1d10。

Magic Missile.name: 魔法飛彈
Magic Missile.description:
你創造出三枚發光的魔法力場飛鏢。每枚飛鏢都會擊中射程內一名你所選擇且能看見的生物。一枚飛鏢會對其目標造成1d4 + 1力場傷害。所有飛鏢會同時命中，且你可以指揮其擊中同一名生物或數名不同的生物。

【升環法術效應】法術位每升一個環階，法術就會多創造一枚飛鏢。

[[2 + @item.level]]{[[lookup @item.level]]環的飛鏢數量}

Sleep.name: 睡眠術
Sleep.description:
選擇射程內一點為中心，半徑5呎球形區域內的每個你所選擇的生物都必須成功通過一次感知豁免，否則陷入&Reference[incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態，直到其下回合結束，此時其必須重複一次豁免。若目標第二次豁免失敗，則目標在法術持續時間內陷入&Reference[unconscious]{昏迷}狀態。若目標承受傷害，或有人在其5呎內採取動作將其從法術效果中搖醒，法術在該目標上終止。

不會睡覺的生物，例如精靈，或者免疫力竭狀態的生物，自動通過對此法術的豁免檢定中。

Sleeping.name: 睡眠
Sleeping.description: 目標陷入&Reference[incapacitated apply=false]{失能}狀態，直到其下回合結束，此時其必須重複一次豁免。若目標第二次豁免失敗，則目標在法術持續時間內陷入&Reference[unconscious]{昏迷}狀態。若目標承受傷害，或有人在其5呎內採取動作將其從法術效果中搖醒，法術在該目標上終止。

Summon Celestial.name: Summon Celestial
Summon Celestial.description:
You call forth a Celestial spirit. It manifests in an angelic form in an unoccupied space that you can see within range and uses the @UUID[Compendium.dnd-players-handbook.actors.Actor.phbmobCelestialS]{Celestial Spirit} stat block. When you cast the spell, choose Avenger or Defender. Your choice determines certain details in its stat block. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 Hit Points or when the spell ends.

The creature is an ally to you and your allies. In combat, the creature shares your Initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes the Dodge action and uses its movement to avoid danger.

【升環法術效應】 Use the spell slot’s level for the spell’s level in the stat block.

In addition to the noted usage of the spell's level in the spirit's Traits and Actions, the following attributes are also affected.

Celestial Spirit
AC11 + the spell’s level + 2 (Defender only)
HP40 + 10 for each spell level above 5
PBequals your Proficiency Bonus

Wall of Stone.name: 石牆術
Wall of Stone.description:
A nonmagical wall of solid stone springs into existence at a point you choose within range. The wall is 6 inches thick and is composed of ten 10-foot-by-10-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel. Alternatively, you can create 10-foot-by-20-foot panels that are only 3 inches thick.

If the wall cuts through a creature’s space when it appears, the creature is pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side). If a creature would be surrounded on all sides by the wall (or the wall and another solid surface), that creature can make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it can use its Reaction to move up to its Speed so that it is no longer enclosed by the wall.

The wall can have any shape you desire, though it can’t occupy the same space as a creature or object. The wall doesn’t need to be vertical or rest on a firm foundation. It must, however, merge with and be solidly supported by existing stone. Thus, you can use this spell to bridge a chasm or create a ramp.

If you create a span greater than 20 feet in length, you must halve the size of each panel to create supports. You can crudely shape the wall to create battlements and the like.

The wall is an object made of stone that can be damaged and thus breached. Each panel has AC 15 and 30 Hit Points per inch of thickness, and it has Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Reducing a panel to 0 Hit Points destroys it and might cause connected panels to collapse at the DM’s discretion.

If you maintain your Concentration on this spell for its full duration, the wall becomes permanent and can’t be dispelled. Otherwise, the wall disappears when the spell ends.
